index 0000000..0dda4d9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/REPRODUCE.md
@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+# Reproducing the Final Experiment Round
+
+All experiment services and harnesses run natively on Windows. WSL is only needed for `attack/attack.sh`; none of the C0–C10 measurement commands need Bash, `jq`, or WSL. The harnesses target `127.0.0.1` only and use a keep-alive HTTP agent.
+
+## Prerequisites
+
+1. Start the Windows Memurai service, then check it with:
+
+   ```powershell
+   & 'C:\Applications\memurai-cli.exe' ping
+   ```
+
+   Expected response: `PONG`. In `server/.env`, set `REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6379`; Memurai listens on IPv4 only in this environment.
+
+2. From PowerShell at the repository root, verify the research dependencies before any run:
+
+   ```powershell
+   node --version
+   & 'C:\Applications\memurai-cli.exe' INFO server
+   Test-NetConnection 127.0.0.1 -Port 6379
+   ```
+
+3. E1/E2/E3/E4 start isolated child server processes with explicit environment values, fresh SQLite paths, and Memurai namespaces. A separate default server on port 3000 is not needed for those harnesses. Existing Phase 0 standalone scripts and race/memory scripts use the already running local server; their environment must match the command metadata and the saved raw artifact.
+
+## Reproduce commands and recorded runtimes
+
+| Result | PowerShell command | Saved output | Recorded runtime |
+|---|---|---|---:|
+| Unit/integration tests | `npm.cmd test 2>&1 | Tee-Object experiments/results/final-round/npm-test.log` | `experiments/results/final-round/npm-test.log` | Current test runtime is printed at the end of the log. |
+| E1 v2 ablation and default-window confirmation | `node experiments/e1/run.js` | `experiments/results/e1-v2/` | 1,148.321 s (`e1-v2/run.json`) |
+| C1 S11 only | `$env:E1_SCENARIO_FILTER='S11'; $env:E1_OUTPUT_DIR='experiments/results/e1-v2-s11'; node experiments/e1/run.js` | `experiments/results/e1-v2-s11/` | 32.509 s (`run.json`) |
+| C2 S10 fast, both policies | `$env:E1_POLICY_SWEEP='true'; $env:E1_SCENARIO_FILTER='S10_fast'; $env:E1_OUTPUT_DIR='experiments/results/s10-policy-fast'; node experiments/e1/run.js` | `experiments/results/s10-policy-fast/` | 44.324 s (`run.json`) |
+| C2 S10 late, both policies | `$env:E1_POLICY_SWEEP='true'; $env:E1_SCENARIO_FILTER='S10_late'; $env:E1_OUTPUT_DIR='experiments/results/s10-policy-late'; node experiments/e1/run.js` | `experiments/results/s10-policy-late/` | 139.527 s (`run.json`) |
+| C2 legitimate post-funding resubmission | `$env:POLICY_RETRY_OUTPUT='experiments/results/s10-policy-resubmit-final'; node experiments/e1/run-policy-resubmit.js` | `experiments/results/s10-policy-resubmit-final/` | `run.json` records elapsed seconds. |
+| E2 v2 load and rejection cost | `node experiments/e2/run.js` | `experiments/results/e2-v2/` | 2,268.197 s (`run.json`) |
+| C5 per-layer table | `node experiments/audit/make-e2-layer-table.js` | `experiments/results/e2-v2/per-layer-coverage-c5.csv` | Under 1 s on the recorded host. |
+| E3 false rejection sweep | `node experiments/e3/run.js` | `experiments/results/e3-v2/` | 933.547 s (`run.json`) |
+| E4a–E4d original scaled-time run | `$env:E4_OUTPUT_DIR='experiments/results/e4-v2-rerun-unique'; node experiments/e4/run.js` | Chosen unique output directory | Prior saved E4 v2 runtime: 401.495 s (`e4-v2/run.json`). A fresh rerun will take the runtime recorded in its new `run.json`. |
+| C3 E4b, 30 replays per case | `$env:E4B_ONLY='true'; $env:E4_OUTPUT_DIR='experiments/results/e4b-rerun-unique'; node experiments/e4/run.js` | Chosen unique output directory, `e4b.csv` | 5.343 s in the saved corrected run. |
+| C3 E4c, 200 transactions/cell | `$env:E4C_ONLY='true'; $env:E4_OUTPUT_DIR='experiments/results/e4c-rerun-unique'; node experiments/e4/run.js` | Chosen unique output directory, `e4c.csv` | 27.511 s in the saved fresh-directory run. |
+| C4 E4a rule check | `node experiments/audit/check-e4a-rule.js` | `experiments/results/e4-v2/e4a-rule-check.json` | Under 1 s. |
+| C9 independent audit | `node experiments/audit/verify-results.js` | `experiments/results/audit/audit-report.json` and `.md` | About 6 s in the saved audit invocation. |
+| Curated facts | `node experiments/audit/build-curated-facts.js` | `docs/PAPER_FACTS_CURATED.md` | Under 2 s. |
+| Results pack | `node experiments/audit/build-results-pack-final.js` | `docs/RESULTS_PACK_A.md` | Under 2 s. |
+
+## Recreate the E1 policy sweep without reusing state
+
+For a new measurement, use a new `E1_OUTPUT_DIR` for every invocation. Each configuration starts a child server and a new SQLite file; do not point a second run at an existing directory. Set the desired scenario filter and policy-sweep flag before launching Node. The recorded `s10-policy-fast` and `s10-policy-late` outputs each contain both policies and all eight configurations with request-ID defense enabled.
+
+The separate resubmission harness starts one fresh server/database per policy/variant cell, and runs 30 failed-withdrawal/funding/retry trials inside it. Use a new `POLICY_RETRY_OUTPUT` directory for every reproduction.
+
+## E4 state isolation
+
+`experiments/e4/run.js` writes per-cell SQLite files under `E4_OUTPUT_DIR`. Choose a previously unused output directory for every run. The first C3 E4c correction reused an existing directory; its attempts were rejected against prior request IDs and it is superseded. The cited C3 E4c run uses a new directory, has 200 transactions per cell, and records the fixed common random loss pattern. E4b uses 30 replay attempts per fault case and calculates Wilson intervals including 0/30 and 30/30.
+
+## Race and nonce memory measurements
+
+These scripts talk to the already-running local Windows server. Save fresh output to a new path and ensure `EXPERIMENT_API` resolves to loopback:
+
+```powershell
+$env:EXPERIMENT_API='http://127.0.0.1:3000'
+$env:RACE_OUTPUT='experiments/results/race-new'
+node experiments/run-races.js
+
+$env:RUN_ID='accepted-new'
+node experiments/run-nonce-memory.js accepted
+$env:RUN_ID='requestid-new'
+node experiments/run-nonce-memory.js requestid
+```
+
+The canonical saved memory runs used `NONCE_TTL=86400`, collected an empty-store `INFO memory` baseline first, measured 0/1k/10k/100k nonce keys, and preserved raw INFO output. Their runtime and duration/TTL ratios are in their JSON summaries. The older unverified 164.96 B/key result is superseded and excluded.
+
+## Reported runtimes and variability
+
+Runtimes above come from saved run metadata, except where the test or offline renderer prints its own runtime. Windows scheduling, CPU power policy, Memurai state, and background load can change a reproduction’s time and latency. Reproduction commands write new results; they do not overwrite the cited final-round result directories when the unique output paths shown above are used.

+# Final Experiment Results Pack
+
+Generated 2026-10-18T18:51:29.438Z. All traffic was directed to the localhost simulation on Windows with Memurai Developer 4.2.3. Latency numbers are localhost-only and support relative comparisons. No Phase 5 work was started.
+
+## Methods and corrections
+
+- E1/E1-S11 use session login, bearer tokens, per-session signing for legitimate traffic, a keep-alive HTTP agent, isolated SQLite databases, per-run Memurai namespaces, and VIZ disabled. “None” disables only the four replay layers; authentication and account ownership remain. S11 attacker requests contain only the captured bearer token and no signature.
+- C2 compares `success_only` (default) and `any_outcome`; all other experiments use `success_only`. S10 fast/late each replay one captured FAILED request 30 times. C2 resubmission trials use 30 distinct failed requests per cell.
+- E3 offsets and delays are simulation assumptions; they are not measured network distributions. Timestamp acceptance uses the same exported helper in `server/utils/timestamp.js` for server and E3 offline validation.
+- E4c initial output and the reused-directory rerun are superseded. Cite only `experiments/results/e4-final-c3-rerun/e4c.csv`. E4b’s earlier one-replay-per-case output is superseded by the 30-trial rerun.
+- Older E1 report field `oracle_total_debited_delta` is an amount, not a debit-row count. `debited_count` is the number of success rows. E1 S10 had one FAILED request ID replayed 30 times, which explains amounts greater than debit-row counts.
+
+## E1 v2 plus S11 token-only forgery

+### S10 original delayed-execution rows
+
+C0: each 30-attempt S10 replay batch replays one captured FAILED request; it has one distinct request ID and one nonce. The harness sets balance to 1, sends a 100-unit withdrawal, then funds with 500, making the balance 501. Five successful 100-unit withdrawals leave 1. Five ledger success rows for one request ID count as four extra duplicate rows (`5 - 1 = 4`). This is the saved E1 result, not a new run.

--- a/docs/THREAT_MODEL.md
+++ b/docs/THREAT_MODEL.md
@@ -19,4 +19,5 @@ The system is a single-process Node/Express bank simulation with SQLite transact
 - The baseline traffic generator possessed the signing secret. The network attacker used for security interpretation does not.
 - The stated network-attacker case assumes login and key delivery are protected by a trusted transport. This workspace defaults to HTTP, so a passive observer who captures the login response can learn the session key; the default deployment therefore does not meet that assumption and cannot support a production network-security claim.
+- Experiment captures can set `PROXY_REDACT_LOGIN=true`. The recording proxy still forwards the login response unchanged to the browser, while its attacker-visible capture replaces both login request and response bodies with redaction markers. This models protected key delivery for the capture-based attacker; it does not add TLS or hide the response from a real on-path observer. The leaked-session-key case is measured separately as E1 scenario S9.
 
 ## Out of scope

+for(const profile of ['P1','P2','P3']){const row=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT,'experiments/results/e3-v2/run.json'),'utf8')).profiles.find(x=>x.id===profile);for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(row))if(k!=='id')add(`E3|${profile}|assumption|${k}`,v,'profile parameter','assumption','experiments/results/e3-v2/run.json','node experiments/e3/run.js','simulation parameter, not real-network measurement');}

+const e4b='experiments/results/e4-final-c3/e4b.csv';for(const r of readCsv(path.join(ROOT,e4b)).filter(r=>r.attempt==='summary'))add(`E4b|${r.case}|replay_availability_Wilson`,`${r.replay_accepted}/${r.replay_total}; ${r.replay_wilson95_low}..${r.replay_wilson95_high}; legitimate ${r.legitimate_accepted}/${r.legitimate_total}`,'replays/attempts; Wilson 95%; legitimate accepts/attempts','measured',e4b,'$env:E4B_ONLY="true"; node experiments/e4/run.js','replay acceptance Wilson score interval; 30 replay attempts per case');

+for(const r of readCsv(path.join(ROOT,e4c)).filter(r=>r.kind==='insufficient-retry'))add(`E4c|insufficient|${r.retry_mode}|retry`,`${r.initial_reason} -> HTTP ${r.retry_status} ${r.retry_reason}`,'response','measured',e4c,'$env:E4C_ONLY="true"; node experiments/e4/run.js');

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const ROOT=path.resolve(__dirname,'../..'),OUT=path.join(ROOT,'experiments/results/s10-policy-tradeoff.csv'),RETRY=path.resolve(process.env.POLICY_RETRY_OUTPUT||path.join(ROOT,'experiments/results/s10-policy-resubmit'));
+function parse(text){const lines=text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);return lines.map(s=>{let a=[],v='',q=false;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){const c=s[i];if(q&&c==='"'&&s[i+1]==='"'){v+='"';i++;}else if(c==='"')q=!q;else if(c===','&&!q){a.push(v);v='';}else v+=c;}a.push(v);return a;});}function read(f){const[h,...d]=parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));return d.map(x=>Object.fromEntries(h.map((k,i)=>[k,x[i]])));}function quote(x){const s=String(x??'');return /[",\r\n]/.test(s)?`"${s.replace(/"/g,'""')}"`:s;}
+const rows=[];for(const [scenario,dir] of [['S10_fast','s10-policy-fast'],['S10_late','s10-policy-late']])for(const r of read(path.join(ROOT,`experiments/results/${dir}/summary.csv`)).filter(x=>x.scenario_id===scenario&&x.config_id.includes('R1-'))){rows.push({kind:'captured_FAILED_replay',policy:r.config_id.endsWith('any_outcome')?'any_outcome':'success_only',configuration:r.config_id.replace(/-any_outcome$|-success_only$/,''),scenario,variant:'one_failed_payload_replayed_30_times',attempts:r.attempts,successes:r.debited_count,failures:Number(r.attempts)-Number(r.debited_count),success_rate:r.attack_success_rate,wilson95_low:r.wilson95_low,wilson95_high:r.wilson95_high,reasons:r.blocking_reason_histogram,delayed_execution_count:r.oracle_delayed_execution_count_delta,duplicate_debit_count:r.oracle_duplicate_debit_count_delta});}
+for(const r of read(path.join(RETRY,'summary.csv')))rows.push({kind:'legitimate_resubmission',policy:r.policy,configuration:'H1T1N1R1',scenario:'after_funding',variant:r.variant,attempts:r.attempts,successes:r.successes,failures:r.failures,success_rate:r.success_rate,wilson95_low:r.wilson95_low,wilson95_high:r.wilson95_high,reasons:r.reason_histogram,delayed_execution_count:'',duplicate_debit_count:''});
+const heads=Object.keys(rows[0]);fs.writeFileSync(OUT,[heads.join(','),...rows.map(r=>heads.map(h=>quote(r[h])).join(','))].join('\n')+'\n');process.stdout.write(`Wrote ${rows.length} policy trade-off rows to ${path.relative(ROOT,OUT)}\n`);

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..65f333f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/experiments/audit/check-e4a-rule.js
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+
+function parseCsv(text) {
+  const lines = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
+  return lines.map((line) => {
+    const cells = []; let value = ''; let quoted = false;
+    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i += 1) {
+      const c = line[i];
+      if (quoted && c === '"' && line[i + 1] === '"') { value += '"'; i += 1; }
+      else if (c === '"') quoted = !quoted;
+      else if (c === ',' && !quoted) { cells.push(value); value = ''; }
+      else value += c;
+    }
+    cells.push(value); return cells;
+  });
+}
+
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..');
+const input = path.join(root, 'experiments/results/e4-v2/e4a-requests.csv');
+const [header, ...data] = parseCsv(fs.readFileSync(input, 'utf8'));
+const rows = data.map((cells) => Object.fromEntries(header.map((key, i) => [key, cells[i]])));
+const groups = new Map();
+for (const row of rows.filter((r) => r.request_id_defense === '0')) {
+  const k = [row.configuration, row.nonce_ttl_seconds, row.client_future_offset_seconds, row.replay_delay_seconds].join('|');
+  const group = groups.get(k) || [];
+  group.push(row); groups.set(k, group);
+}
+const violations = []; const flips = [];
+for (const [key, cell] of groups) {
+  const [configuration, ttlText, futureText, delayText] = key.split('|');
+  const ttl = Number(ttlText), future = Number(futureText), delay = Number(delayText);
+  const predicted = ttl <= delay && delay < 6 + future;
+  const accepted = cell.filter((r) => r.replay_accepted === '1').length;
+  const actual = accepted > 0;
+  if (cell.length !== 30 || actual !== predicted) violations.push({ configuration, ttl, future, delay, trials: cell.length, accepted, expectedAcceptedCell: predicted });
+  flips.push({ configuration, ttl, future, delay, accepted, trials: cell.length, expectedAcceptedCell: predicted });
+}
+const cells = [...groups.values()].length;
+const ranges=new Map();for(const r of flips){const k=[r.configuration,r.ttl,r.future].join('|');const a=ranges.get(k)||[];a.push(r);ranges.set(k,a);}const boundaryTransitions=[];for(const [k,a] of ranges){a.sort((x,y)=>x.delay-y.delay);for(let i=1;i<a.length;i++){const prev=a[i-1],next=a[i];if((prev.accepted===30)!==(next.accepted===30))boundaryTransitions.push({configuration:prev.configuration,ttl:prev.ttl,future_offset:prev.future,from_delay:prev.delay,from_accepted:prev.accepted,to_delay:next.delay,to_accepted:next.accepted});}}
+const result = { input: path.relative(root, input).replace(/\\/g, '/'), cells, trialsPerCell: 30, requestIdDefense: 0, rule: 'accepted iff TTL <= delay < PAST(6s) + future_offset', violatingCells: violations.length, violations, boundaryTransitions, checkedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
+const output = path.join(root, 'experiments/results/e4-v2/e4a-rule-check.json');
+fs.writeFileSync(output, `${JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)}\n`);
+process.stdout.write(`E4a cells=${cells}, violations=${violations.length}, output=${path.relative(root, output)}\n`);

+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+function csv(text){const lines=text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);return lines.map(line=>{const out=[];let v='',q=false;for(let i=0;i<line.length;i++){const c=line[i];if(q&&c==='"'&&line[i+1]==='"'){v+='"';i++;}else if(c==='"')q=!q;else if(c===','&&!q){out.push(v);v='';}else v+=c;}out.push(v);return out;});}
+function stats(values){const sorted=[...values].sort((a,b)=>a-b),mean=values.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/values.length,s2=values.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b-mean)**2,0)/(values.length-1),margin=2.2621571627409915*Math.sqrt(s2/values.length);return{median:sorted.length%2?sorted[(sorted.length-1)/2]:(sorted[sorted.length/2-1]+sorted[sorted.length/2])/2,low:mean-margin,high:mean+margin};}
+const root=path.resolve(__dirname,'../..'),file=path.join(root,'experiments/results/e2-v2/layer-timing-summary.csv');
+const [head,...data]=csv(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8')),rows=data.map(c=>Object.fromEntries(head.map((h,i)=>[h,c[i]])));
+const stackIds=['all_four','nonce_redis','nonce_sqlite','nonce_memory'],layers=['hmac','timestamp','nonce','request_id','handler_total'];const output=[];
+for(const stack of stackIds){const subset=rows.filter(r=>r.stack_id===stack),repeats=[...new Set(subset.map(r=>r.repeat))];for(const layer of layers){const values=repeats.map(rep=>Number(subset.find(r=>r.repeat===rep&&r.layer===layer).p50_ns));const s=stats(values);output.push({stack_id:stack,layer,repeats:values.length,p50_median_ns:s.median,t_ci95_low_ns:s.low,t_ci95_high_ns:s.high,p50_median_us:s.median/1000,t_ci95_low_us:s.low/1000,t_ci95_high_us:s.high/1000});}}
+for(const stack of stackIds){const subset=rows.filter(r=>r.stack_id===stack),repeats=[...new Set(subset.map(r=>r.repeat))];const shares=repeats.map(rep=>['hmac','timestamp','nonce','request_id'].reduce((s,layer)=>s+Number(subset.find(r=>r.repeat===rep&&r.layer===layer).p50_ns),0)/Number(subset.find(r=>r.repeat===rep&&r.layer==='handler_total').p50_ns));const s=stats(shares);output.push({stack_id:stack,layer:'four_layer_share',repeats:shares.length,p50_median_ns:'',t_ci95_low_ns:'',t_ci95_high_ns:'',p50_median_us:100*s.median,t_ci95_low_us:100*s.low,t_ci95_high_us:100*s.high});}
+function quote(x){const s=x==null?'':String(x);return /[",\r\n]/.test(s)?`"${s.replace(/"/g,'""')}"`:s;}
+const headers=Object.keys(output[0]);const outPath=path.join(root,'experiments/results/e2-v2/per-layer-coverage-c5.csv');fs.writeFileSync(outPath,[headers.join(','),...output.map(r=>headers.map(h=>quote(r[h])).join(','))].join('\n')+'\n');
+process.stdout.write(`C5 rows=${output.length}, source=${path.relative(root,file)}, output=${path.relative(root,outPath)}\n`);

+

diff --git a/experiments/e1/finalize-oracle-summary.js b/experiments/e1/finalize-oracle-summary.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ef2075e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/experiments/e1/finalize-oracle-summary.js
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..');
+const output = path.resolve(process.env.E1_OUTPUT_DIR || path.join(root, 'experiments/results/e1-sqlite-final'));
+const run = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(output, 'run.json'), 'utf8'));
+const runDirectory = path.join(output, run.dataRunDirectory);
+function parseCsv(text) {
+  const parseLine = (line) => {
+    const values = []; let value = ''; let quoted = false;
+    for (let index = 0; index < line.length; index += 1) {
+      const char = line[index];
+      if (quoted && char === '"' && line[index + 1] === '"') { value += '"'; index += 1; }
+      else if (char === '"') quoted = !quoted;
+      else if (char === ',' && !quoted) { values.push(value); value = ''; }
+      else value += char;
+    }
+    values.push(value); return values;
+  };
+  const lines = text.trimEnd().split(/\r?\n/);
+  const headers = parseLine(lines[0]);
+  return { headers, rows: lines.slice(1).map(parseLine) };
+}
+function writeCsv(file, headers, rows) {
+  const q = (value) => { const s = value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value); return /[",\r\n]/.test(s) ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s; };
+  fs.writeFileSync(file, `${[headers.join(','), ...rows.map((row) => headers.map((key) => q(row[key])).join(','))].join('\n')}\n`);
+}
+let proxyTimingRows = 0;
+for (const name of fs.readdirSync(runDirectory)) {
+  const directory = path.join(runDirectory, name);
+  if (!fs.statSync(directory).isDirectory()) continue;
+  const stdout = path.join(directory, 'proxy.stdout.log');
+  if (!fs.existsSync(stdout)) continue;
+  const match = fs.readFileSync(stdout, 'utf8').match(/capture file:\s*(.+)/);
+  if (!match) continue;
+  const log = `${match[1].trim()}.jsonl`;
+  if (!fs.existsSync(log)) continue;
+  const timings = fs.readFileSync(log, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).map((line) => {
+    const item = JSON.parse(line);
+    return { method: item.request.method, path: item.request.path, start_ns: item.start_ns, end_ns: item.end_ns, duration_ns: item.duration_ns, http_status: item.response.statusCode };
+  });
+  if (timings.length) {
+    proxyTimingRows += timings.length;
+    writeCsv(path.join(directory, 'proxy-request-timings.csv'), ['method', 'path', 'start_ns', 'end_ns', 'duration_ns', 'http_status'], timings);
+  }
+}
+const summaryFile = path.join(runDirectory, 'summary.csv');
+const parsed = parseCsv(fs.readFileSync(summaryFile, 'utf8'));
+const rows = parsed.rows.map((cells) => Object.fromEntries(parsed.headers.map((header, index) => [header, cells[index]])));
+for (const row of rows) {
+  if (row.scenario_id === 'LEGITIMATE_CONTROL') continue;
+  row.oracle_integrity_holds = Number(row.oracle_duplicate_debit_count_delta) === 0 && Number(row.oracle_unauthorized_debit_amount_delta) === 0;
+}
+writeCsv(summaryFile, parsed.headers, rows);
+fs.copyFileSync(summaryFile, path.join(output, 'summary.csv'));
+const latex = ['\\begin{tabular}{llrrrrl}', '\\toprule', 'Configuration & Scenario & Attempts & Accepted & Debits & Success rate & Wilson 95\\% CI \\\\', '\\midrule', ...rows.filter((row) => row.scenario_id !== 'LEGITIMATE_CONTROL').map((row) => `${row.config_id} & ${row.scenario_id} & ${row.attempts} & ${row.http_accepted_count} & ${row.debited_count} & ${(100 * Number(row.attack_success_rate)).toFixed(2)}\\% & ${row.wilson95_low === '' ? 'constant outcome' : `${Number(row.wilson95_low).toFixed(4)}--${Number(row.wilson95_high).toFixed(4)}`} \\\\`), '\\bottomrule', '\\end{tabular}', ''];
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(runDirectory, 'summary.tex'), latex.join('\n'));
+fs.copyFileSync(path.join(runDirectory, 'summary.tex'), path.join(output, 'summary.tex'));
+run.allSummaries = rows;
+fs.writeFileSync(path.join(runDirectory, 'run.json'), `${JSON.stringify(run, null, 2)}\n`);
+fs.copyFileSync(path.join(runDirectory, 'run.json'), path.join(output, 'run.json'));
+process.stdout.write(`Finalized ${rows.length} E1 summary rows from direct SQLite oracle deltas and ${proxyTimingRows} proxy-request timing rows in ${summaryFile}.\n`);

+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),crypto=require('crypto');
+const sqlite3=require('../../server/node_modules/sqlite3').verbose();
+const {computeMoneyIntegrity}=require('../../server/utils/money-oracle');
+const ROOT=path.resolve(__dirname,'../..'),OUT=path.resolve(process.env.E1_OUTPUT_DIR||path.join(ROOT,'experiments/results/e1-v2'));
+const run=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(OUT,'run.json'),'utf8')),runDir=path.join(OUT,run.dataRunDirectory);
+const seed='e1-fixed-seed-2026-v1';let sequence=0;
+function deterministicId(scope){return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${seed}|${scope}|${sequence++}`).digest('hex').slice(0,32);}
+function csvRows(text){const lines=text.trimEnd().split(/\r?\n/);const parse=line=>{const a=[];let v='',q=false;for(let i=0;i<line.length;i++){const c=line[i];if(q&&c==='"'&&line[i+1]==='"'){v+='"';i++;}else if(c==='"')q=!q;else if(c===','&&!q){a.push(v);v='';}else v+=c;}a.push(v);return a;};const h=parse(lines[0]);return lines.slice(1).map(line=>Object.fromEntries(h.map((k,i)=>[k,parse(line)[i]??''])));}
+function write(file,rows){const headers=[...new Set(rows.flatMap(Object.keys))];const q=v=>{v=v==null?'':String(v);return /[",\r\n]/.test(v)?`"${v.replace(/"/g,'""')}"`:v;};fs.writeFileSync(file,[headers.join(','),...rows.map(r=>headers.map(k=>q(r[k])).join(','))].join('\n')+'\n');}
+function baseline(scope,count){const ids=[];for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const req=`e1-${deterministicId(scope)}`,nonce=deterministicId(scope);void nonce;ids.push(req);}return ids;}
+function dbRows(file){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const db=new sqlite3.Database(file);db.all('SELECT id,request_id,type,status,amount FROM transactions ORDER BY id',[],(err,rows)=>db.close(()=>err?reject(err):resolve(rows)));});}
+async function main(){const outputs=[];
+  for(let mask=0;mask<16;mask++){
+    const id=`H${mask&1?1:0}T${mask&2?1:0}N${mask&4?1:0}R${mask&8?1:0}`;
+    const scenarios=new Map();
+    const control=baseline(id,30);scenarios.set('LEGITIMATE_CONTROL',{ids:control,baseIds:control,authorized:control.map(request_id=>({request_id,amount:1,type:'WITHDRAW'}))});
+    for(const name of ['S1','S2','S3','S4']){const ids=baseline(id,30);scenarios.set(name,{ids,baseIds:ids,authorized:ids.map(request_id=>({request_id,amount:1,type:'WITHDRAW'}))});}
+    const s5=[];for(let i=0;i<30;i++)s5.push(...baseline(id,1));scenarios.set('S5',{ids:s5,baseIds:s5,authorized:s5.map(request_id=>({request_id,amount:1,type:'WITHDRAW'}))});
+    for(const name of ['S6','S7a','S7b','S8']){const ids=baseline(id,30);const all=name==='S7a'?[...ids,...ids.map(x=>`${x}-changed`)]:ids;scenarios.set(name,{ids:all,baseIds:ids,authorized:ids.map(request_id=>({request_id,amount:1,type:'WITHDRAW'}))});}
+    const s9seed=baseline(id,1);const s9forged=baseline(id,30);scenarios.set('S9',{ids:[...s9seed,...s9forged],baseIds:s9seed,authorized:s9seed.map(request_id=>({request_id,amount:1,type:'WITHDRAW'}))});
+    for(const name of ['S10_fast','S10_late']){const request_id=`s10-${deterministicId(id)}`;deterministicId(id);const fundingNonce=deterministicId(id),fundingRequest=deterministicId(id);void fundingNonce;void fundingRequest;scenarios.set(name,{ids:[request_id],baseIds:[],authorized:[{request_id,amount:100,type:'WITHDRAW'}]});}
+    const sql=path.join(runDir,`${id}.sqlite`),ledger=await dbRows(sql);
+    for(const [scenario,meta] of scenarios){const rows=ledger.filter(r=>meta.ids.includes(r.request_id));const baselineRows=meta.baseIds.map(requestId=>ledger.find(r=>r.request_id===requestId&&r.status==='SUCCESS'&&r.type==='WITHDRAW')).filter(Boolean);const oracle=computeMoneyIntegrity(rows,meta.authorized);const delta=oracle.total_debited-baselineRows.reduce((sum,r)=>sum+Number(r.amount),0);const summary=csvRows(fs.readFileSync(path.join(OUT,'summary.csv'),'utf8')).find(r=>r.config_id===id&&r.scenario_id===scenario);

+async function server(env,dir){const out=fs.openSync(path.join(dir,'server.stdout.log'),'a'),err=fs.openSync(path.join(dir,'server.stderr.log'),'a'),child=spawn(process.execPath,['server.js'],{cwd:path.join(ROOT,'server'),env,stdio:['ignore',out,err],windowsHide:true});child.once('exit',()=>{try{fs.closeSync(out)}catch{}try{fs.closeSync(err)}catch{}});for(let i=0;i<200;i++){if(child.exitCode!==null)throw Error(`server exited; see ${dir}`);try{if((await timedRequest('http://127.0.0.1:3600/api/health')).status===200)return child}catch{}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}throw Error(`health timeout ${dir}`);}

+function payload(s,id,nonce,pathName='/api/withdraw',amount=100){const p={method:'POST',path:pathName,user_id:'anis_101',account_id:'acc_777',amount,currency:'BDT',timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),nonce,request_id:id};p.signature=generateSignature(p,s.sessionKey);return p;}
+async function post(p,s){return timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:3600${p.path}`,{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json',authorization:`Bearer ${s.sessionToken}`},body:JSON.stringify(p)});}
+async function run(policy,variant){const id=`${policy}-${variant}`,dir=path.join(OUT,id);fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});const started=new Date(),env={...process.env,PORT:'3600',HOST:'127.0.0.1',VIZ_ENABLED:'false',DEMO_MODE:'false',LEGACY_SHARED_SECRET:'false',ENABLE_DEMO_ROUTES:'false',IDEMPOTENCY_POLICY:policy,NONCE_STORE:'redis',NONCE_TTL:'86400',REDIS_URL:'redis://127.0.0.1:6379',NONCE_KEY_NAMESPACE:`policy-${id}-${process.pid}`,SQLITE_DB:path.join(dir,'run.sqlite'),TIMESTAMP_PAST_WINDOW_SECONDS:'300',TIMESTAMP_FUTURE_WINDOW_SECONDS:'5',DEFENSE_HMAC:'true',DEFENSE_TIMESTAMP:'true',DEFENSE_NONCE:'true',DEFENSE_REQUEST_ID:'true',EXPERIMENT_LOG:path.join(dir,'server-timings.csv')};let child,session,db;const rows=[],reasons={};let successes=0;try{child=await server(env,dir);db=new sqlite3.Database(env.SQLITE_DB);session=(await timedRequest('http://127.0.0.1:3600/api/login',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({user_id:'anis_101',pin:process.env.DEMO_PIN||'1234'})})).body;

+const ci=wilson(successes,30);return {rows,summary:{policy,variant,attempts:30,successes,failures:30-successes,success_rate:successes/30,wilson95_low:ci[0],wilson95_high:ci[1],reason_histogram:JSON.stringify(reasons),started:started.toISOString(),ended:new Date().toISOString()}};}

+++ b/experiments/e1/run.js
@@ -0,0 +1,356 @@
+const fs = require('fs');
+const os = require('os');
+const path = require('path');
+const crypto = require('crypto');
+const { spawn } = require('child_process');
+require('../../server/node_modules/dotenv').config({ path: path.resolve(__dirname, '../../server/.env') });
+const { generateSignature } = require('../../server/utils/hmac');
+const { computeMoneyIntegrity } = require('../../server/utils/money-oracle');
+const sqlite3 = require('../../server/node_modules/sqlite3').verbose();
+const { timedRequest } = require('../lib/http');
+
+const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..');
+const SERVER = path.join(ROOT, 'server');
+const OUTPUT = path.resolve(process.env.E1_OUTPUT_DIR || path.join(ROOT, 'experiments/results/e1-v2'));
+const RUN_TAG = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
+const RUN_OUTPUT = path.join(OUTPUT, RUN_TAG);
+const RANDOM_SEED = 'e1-fixed-seed-2026-v1';
+const WIDTH = 30;
+const PAST = 6;
+const FUTURE = 2;
+const NONCE_TTL = 4;
+const SESSION_TTL = 15;
+const PIN = process.env.DEMO_PIN || '1234';
+fs.mkdirSync(OUTPUT, { recursive: true });
+
+const csv = (value) => {
+  const text = value === undefined || value === null ? '' : String(value);
+  return /[",\r\n]/.test(text) ? `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : text;
+};
+const writeCsv = (file, headers, rows) => fs.writeFileSync(file, `${[headers.join(','), ...rows.map((row) => headers.map((key) => csv(row[key])).join(','))].join('\n')}\n`);
+const wilson = (successes, n) => {
+  if (!n) return [0, 1];
+  const z = 1.959963984540054;
+  const p = successes / n;
+  const d = 1 + z * z / n;
+  const center = (p + z * z / (2 * n)) / d;
+  const margin = z * Math.sqrt((p * (1 - p) + z * z / (4 * n)) / n) / d;
+  return [Math.max(0, center - margin), Math.min(1, center + margin)];
+};
+const shortHash = (value) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(String(value)).digest('hex').slice(0, 12);
+let deterministicSequence = 0;
+const deterministicId = (scope) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${RANDOM_SEED}|${scope}|${deterministicSequence++}`).digest('hex').slice(0, 32);
+
+async function waitHealth(port, child, log) {
+  const deadline = Date.now() + 30000;
+  const rows = [];
+  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
+    if (child.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`Server exited early; see ${log}`);
+    try {
+      const response = await timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/health`);
+      rows.push({ start_ns: response.start_ns, end_ns: response.end_ns, duration_ns: response.duration_ns, http_status: response.status, outcome: response.status === 200 ? 'READY' : 'NOT_READY' });
+      if (response.status === 200) { writeCsv(path.join(path.dirname(log), 'health-readiness.csv'), Object.keys(rows[0]), rows); return; }
+    } catch (error) { rows.push({ start_ns: error.start_ns, end_ns: error.end_ns, duration_ns: error.duration_ns, http_status: '', outcome: 'CONNECT_ERROR' }); }
+    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
+  }
+  if (rows.length) writeCsv(path.join(path.dirname(log), 'health-readiness.csv'), Object.keys(rows[0]), rows);
+  throw new Error(`Server health timed out; see ${log}`);
+}
+
+function spawnLogged(exe, args, options, stdout, stderr) {
+  const out = fs.openSync(stdout, 'a');
+  const err = fs.openSync(stderr, 'a');
+  const child = spawn(exe, args, { ...options, stdio: ['ignore', out, err], windowsHide: true });
+  child.once('exit', () => { try { fs.closeSync(out); } catch {} try { fs.closeSync(err); } catch {} });
+  return child;
+}
+
+async function stop(child) {
+  if (!child || child.exitCode !== null) return;
+  child.kill();
+  await Promise.race([new Promise((resolve) => child.once('exit', resolve)), new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 3000))]);
+  if (child.exitCode === null && child.pid) spawn('taskkill', ['/PID', String(child.pid), '/T', '/F'], { stdio: 'ignore', windowsHide: true });
+}
+
+function parseCaptures(logPath) {
+  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
+  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).map((line) => JSON.parse(line));
+}
+
+async function runConfiguration(mask, profile = {}) {
+  const past = profile.past ?? PAST;
+  const future = profile.future ?? FUTURE;
+  const nonceTtl = profile.nonceTtl ?? NONCE_TTL;
+  const sessionTtl = profile.sessionTtl ?? SESSION_TTL;
+  const policy = profile.idempotencyPolicy || process.env.IDEMPOTENCY_POLICY || 'success_only';
+  const id = `H${mask & 1 ? 1 : 0}T${mask & 2 ? 1 : 0}N${mask & 4 ? 1 : 0}R${mask & 8 ? 1 : 0}${profile.suffix || ''}`;
+  const port = 3200;
+  const vizPort = 3201;
+  const proxyPort = 3202;
+  const namespace = `e1-${id.toLowerCase()}-${process.pid}`;
+  const runDir = path.join(RUN_OUTPUT, id);
+  fs.mkdirSync(runDir, { recursive: true });
+  const captureBase = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `cs-e1-${id}-${process.pid}.json`);
+  const captureLog = `${captureBase}.jsonl`;
+  const serverEnv = {
+    ...process.env,
+    PORT: String(port), HOST: '127.0.0.1', VIZ_PORT: String(vizPort),
+    VIZ_ENABLED: 'false', DEMO_MODE: 'false', LEGACY_SHARED_SECRET: 'false',
+    ENABLE_DEMO_ROUTES: 'true', NONCE_STORE: 'redis', NONCE_TTL: String(nonceTtl),
+    REDIS_URL: 'redis://127.0.0.1:6379',
+    NONCE_KEY_NAMESPACE: namespace, SQLITE_DB: path.join(RUN_OUTPUT, `${id}.sqlite`),
+    TIMESTAMP_PAST_WINDOW_SECONDS: String(past), TIMESTAMP_FUTURE_WINDOW_SECONDS: String(future), SESSION_TTL: String(sessionTtl),
+    DEFENSE_HMAC: String(Boolean(mask & 1)), DEFENSE_TIMESTAMP: String(Boolean(mask & 2)),
+    DEFENSE_NONCE: String(Boolean(mask & 4)), DEFENSE_REQUEST_ID: String(Boolean(mask & 8)),
+    IDEMPOTENCY_POLICY: policy,
+    EXPERIMENT_LOG: path.join(runDir, 'server-timings.csv'), CONFIG_ID: id, SCENARIO_ID: 'e1', RUN_ID: `e1-${Date.now()}`
+  };
+  const server = spawnLogged(process.execPath, ['server.js'], { cwd: SERVER, env: serverEnv }, path.join(runDir, 'server.stdout.log'), path.join(runDir, 'server.stderr.log'));
+  const proxyEnv = { ...process.env, PROXY_UPSTREAM: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`, PROXY_PORT: String(proxyPort), PROXY_CAPTURE_FILE: captureBase, PROXY_WITHDRAW_CAPTURE_FILE: `${captureBase}.withdraw.json`, PROXY_REDACT_LOGIN: 'true' };
+  let proxy;
+  const requestRows = [];
+  const summaries = [];
+  let session = null;
+  let ledgerDb = null;
+  let sequence = 0;
+
+  async function startProxy() {
+    proxy = spawnLogged(process.execPath, [path.join(ROOT, 'experiments/recording-proxy.js')], { cwd: ROOT, env: proxyEnv }, path.join(runDir, 'proxy.stdout.log'), path.join(runDir, 'proxy.stderr.log'));
+    const deadline = Date.now() + 10000;
+    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
+      if (proxy.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`Proxy exited; see ${runDir}`);
+      try { await timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${proxyPort}/api/health`); return; } catch {}
+      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
+    }
+    throw new Error(`Proxy health timed out: ${runDir}`);
+  }
+
+  async function login() {
+    const result = await timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${proxyPort}/api/login`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ user_id: 'anis_101', pin: PIN }) });
+    if (result.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Session login failed with HTTP ${result.status}`);
+    session = result.body;
+  }
+
+  function signedPayload({ requestId = `e1-${deterministicId(id)}`, nonce = `n-${deterministicId(id)}`, amount = 1 } = {}, signingKey = session.sessionKey) {
+    const payload = { method: 'POST', path: '/api/withdraw', user_id: 'anis_101', account_id: 'acc_777', amount, currency: 'BDT', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), nonce, request_id: requestId };
+    payload.signature = generateSignature(payload, signingKey);
+    return payload;
+  }
+
+  async function submit(payload, token = session.sessionToken) {
+    return timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${proxyPort}/api/withdraw`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
+  }
+
+  function findCapture(requestId) {
+    const record = parseCaptures(captureLog).reverse().find((entry) => {
+      if (entry.request.method !== 'POST' || new URL(entry.request.path, 'http://localhost').pathname !== '/api/withdraw') return false;
+      try { return JSON.parse(entry.request.body).request_id === requestId; } catch { return false; }
+    });
+    if (!record) throw new Error(`Attacker-visible proxy capture missing for request ${shortHash(requestId)}`);
+    return record;
+  }
+
+  async function replay(capture, mutate = (body) => body) {
+    const body = mutate(JSON.parse(capture.request.body));
+    const headers = { 'content-type': 'application/json' };
+    const authorization = capture.request.headers.authorization;
+    if (authorization) headers.authorization = authorization;
+    return timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${proxyPort}/api/withdraw`, { method: 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
+  }
+
+  async function ledger() {
+    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => ledgerDb.all('SELECT id, request_id, type, status, amount FROM transactions ORDER BY id', [], (error, rows) => error ? reject(error) : resolve(rows)));
+  }
+
+  async function baseline(label, count, addAuthorization = true) {
+    const captures = [];
+    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
+      const payload = signedPayload();
+      const response = await submit(payload);
+      if (response.status !== 200 || response.body.status !== 'ACCEPTED') throw new Error(`${id}/${label}: baseline rejected (${response.status}/${response.body.reason || response.body.error})`);
+      if (addAuthorization) authorized.push({ request_id: payload.request_id, amount: payload.amount, type: 'WITHDRAW' });
+      captures.push(findCapture(payload.request_id));
+      requestRows.push({ config_id: id, scenario_id: label, variant: '', attempt: i + 1, phase: 'legitimate', request_id_hash: shortHash(payload.request_id), start_ns: response.start_ns, end_ns: response.end_ns, duration_ns: response.duration_ns, http_status: response.status, outcome: response.body.status, reason: '' });
+    }
+    return captures;
+  }
+
+  const authorized = [];
+
+  async function measureScenario(name, attempts, action, options = {}) {
+    const beforeLedger = await ledger();
+    const beforeRows = beforeLedger.filter((row) => row.status === 'SUCCESS' && row.type === 'WITHDRAW').length;
+    const beforeOracle = computeMoneyIntegrity(beforeLedger, authorized);
+    const results = await action();
+    const afterLedger = await ledger();
+    const afterRows = afterLedger.filter((row) => row.status === 'SUCCESS' && row.type === 'WITHDRAW').length;
+    const afterOracle = computeMoneyIntegrity(afterLedger, authorized);
+    const debited = afterRows - beforeRows;
+    const accepted = results.filter((r) => r.status === 200 && r.body.status === 'ACCEPTED').length;
+    const duplicateDelta = afterOracle.duplicate_debit_count - beforeOracle.duplicate_debit_count;
+    const duplicateAmountDelta = afterOracle.duplicate_debit_amount - beforeOracle.duplicate_debit_amount;
+    const unauthorizedDelta = afterOracle.unauthorized_debit_amount - beforeOracle.unauthorized_debit_amount;
+    const reasons = {};
+    results.forEach((r) => { const reason = r.body.reason || r.body.error || r.body.status || `HTTP_${r.status}`; reasons[reason] = (reasons[reason] || 0) + 1; });
+    const interval = wilson(debited, attempts);
+    summaries.push({ config_id: id, scenario_id: name, variant: options.variant || '', attempts, http_accepted_count: accepted, debited_count: debited, attack_success_rate: attempts ? debited / attempts : 0, wilson95_low: interval[0], wilson95_high: interval[1], blocking_reason_histogram: JSON.stringify(reasons), oracle_total_debited_delta: afterOracle.total_debited - beforeOracle.total_debited, oracle_duplicate_debit_count_delta: duplicateDelta, oracle_duplicate_debit_amount_delta: duplicateAmountDelta, oracle_unauthorized_debit_amount_delta: unauthorizedDelta, oracle_delayed_execution_count_delta: afterOracle.delayed_execution_count - beforeOracle.delayed_execution_count, oracle_delayed_execution_amount_delta: afterOracle.delayed_execution_amount - beforeOracle.delayed_execution_amount, oracle_integrity_holds: duplicateDelta === 0 && unauthorizedDelta === 0 });
+    return results;
+  }
+

diff --git a/experiments/lib/http.js b/experiments/lib/http.js
index 00c1752..f72b697 100644
--- a/experiments/lib/http.js
+++ b/experiments/lib/http.js
@@ -1,17 +1,36 @@
-async function timedRequest(url, options = {}) {
-  const start = process.hrtime.bigint();
-  const response = await fetch(url, options);
-  const text = await response.text();
-  const end = process.hrtime.bigint();
-  let body;
-  try { body = JSON.parse(text); } catch { body = text; }
-  return {
-    start_ns: start.toString(),
-    end_ns: end.toString(),
-    duration_ns: (end - start).toString(),
-    status: response.status,
-    body
-  };
+const http = require('http');
+const https = require('https');
+const agents = { 'http:': new http.Agent({ keepAlive: true }), 'https:': new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true }) };
+
+function timedRequest(input, options = {}) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const url = new URL(input);
+    const start = process.hrtime.bigint();
+    const request = (url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http).request(url, {
+      method: options.method || 'GET',
+      headers: options.headers || {},
+      agent: agents[url.protocol]
+    }, (response) => {
+      const chunks = [];
+      response.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));
+      response.on('end', () => {
+        const end = process.hrtime.bigint();
+        const text = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
+        let body;
+        try { body = JSON.parse(text); } catch { body = text; }
+        resolve({ start_ns: start.toString(), end_ns: end.toString(), duration_ns: (end - start).toString(), status: response.statusCode, headers: response.headers, body });
+      });
+    });
+    request.on('error', (error) => {
+      const end = process.hrtime.bigint();
+      error.start_ns = start.toString();
+      error.end_ns = end.toString();
+      error.duration_ns = (end - start).toString();
+      reject(error);
+    });
+    if (options.body !== undefined) request.write(options.body);
+    request.end();
+  });
 }
 
-module.exports = { timedRequest };
+module.exports = { timedRequest, keepAlive: true, agents };

diff --git a/experiments/render-pack-a.py b/experiments/render-pack-a.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bae4dff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/experiments/render-pack-a.py
@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+import csv
+import os
+import sys
+
+import matplotlib
+matplotlib.use('Agg')
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import numpy as np
+
+root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+e1_dir = os.path.join(root, 'experiments', 'results', 'e1-sqlite-final')
+e2_dir = os.path.join(root, 'experiments', 'results', 'e2')
+
+with open(os.path.join(e1_dir, 'summary.csv'), newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+    e1_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
+configs = []
+scenarios = [f'S{i}' for i in range(1, 10)]
+for row in e1_rows:
+    if row['scenario_id'] in scenarios and row['config_id'] not in configs:
+        configs.append(row['config_id'])
+matrix = np.full((len(configs), len(scenarios)), np.nan)
+for row in e1_rows:
+    if row['scenario_id'] in scenarios and row['config_id'] in configs and row['attack_success_rate']:
+        matrix[configs.index(row['config_id']), scenarios.index(row['scenario_id'])] = float(row['attack_success_rate'])
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, max(6, len(configs) * 0.42)), constrained_layout=True)
+image = ax.imshow(matrix, cmap='YlOrRd', vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect='auto')
+ax.set_xticks(range(len(scenarios)), scenarios)
+ax.set_yticks(range(len(configs)), configs)
+ax.set_xlabel('Attack scenario')
+ax.set_ylabel('Defense configuration')
+ax.set_title('E1 attack success rate (SQLite ledger debit count / attempts)')
+for i in range(len(configs)):
+    for j in range(len(scenarios)):
+        value = matrix[i, j]
+        ax.text(j, i, '—' if np.isnan(value) else f'{value:.2f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, color='black')
+fig.colorbar(image, ax=ax, label='Attack success rate')
+for ext in ('png', 'pdf', 'svg'):
+    fig.savefig(os.path.join(e1_dir, f'attack-success-heatmap.{ext}'), dpi=200)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+with open(os.path.join(e2_dir, 'load-repeat-summary.csv'), newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+    e2_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
+stacks = list(dict.fromkeys(row['stack_id'] for row in e2_rows))
+x = np.arange(len(stacks))
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 6), constrained_layout=True)
+width = 0.36
+for offset, concurrency in enumerate(('1', '16')):
+    vals, low, high = [], [], []
+    for stack in stacks:
+        row = next((item for item in e2_rows if item['stack_id'] == stack and item['concurrency'] == concurrency), None)
+        vals.append(float(row['mean_repeat_median_ms']) if row else 0)
+        low.append(float(row['mean_repeat_median_ms']) - float(row['ci95_low_ms']) if row else 0)
+        high.append(float(row['ci95_high_ms']) - float(row['mean_repeat_median_ms']) if row else 0)
+    ax.bar(x + (offset - .5) * width, vals, width, yerr=[low, high], capsize=3, label=f'Concurrency {concurrency}')
+ax.set_xticks(x, stacks, rotation=30, ha='right')
+ax.set_ylabel('Mean per-repeat median latency (ms)')
+ax.set_title('E2 end-to-end latency with 95% CI across five repeat medians')
+ax.legend()
+for ext in ('png', 'pdf', 'svg'):
+    fig.savefig(os.path.join(e2_dir, f'latency-by-stack.{ext}'), dpi=200)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+with open(os.path.join(e2_dir, 'load-repeat-summary.csv'), newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
+with open(os.path.join(e2_dir, 'load-summary.tex'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+    f.write('\\begin{tabular}{lrrrrr}\n\\toprule\nStack & C & Mean median (ms) & 95\\% CI low & 95\\% CI high & Repeats \\\\\n\\midrule\n')
+    for row in rows:
+        f.write(f"{row['stack_id']} & {row['concurrency']} & {float(row['mean_repeat_median_ms']):.4f} & {float(row['ci95_low_ms']):.4f} & {float(row['ci95_high_ms']):.4f} & {row['repetitions']} \\\\\n")
+    f.write('\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular}\n')
+
+with open(os.path.join(e2_dir, 'rejection-cost.csv'), newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
+with open(os.path.join(e2_dir, 'rejection-cost.tex'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+    f.write('\\begin{tabular}{llrrrr}\n\\toprule\nOrder & Flood & Attempts & Mean ms & p95 ms & Rejected \\\\\n\\midrule\n')
+    for row in rows:
+        f.write(f"{row['check_order']} & {row['flood']} & {row['attempts']} & {float(row['mean_duration_ms']):.4f} & {float(row['p95_ms']):.4f} & {row['rejected_count']} \\\\\n")
+    f.write('\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular}\n')
+
+print(f'matplotlib {matplotlib.__version__}; wrote E1 heatmap and E2 latency figure in PNG, PDF, SVG plus LaTeX tables')
diff --git a/experiments/render-v2-results.py b/experiments/render-v2-results.py

+import csv, os, sys
+import matplotlib
+matplotlib.use('Agg')
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT=os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+E1=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e1-v2')
+E2ROOT=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e2-v2')
+E2=E2ROOT
+if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(E2,'load-repeat-summary.csv')) and os.path.isdir(E2ROOT):
+    candidates=[os.path.join(E2ROOT,n) for n in os.listdir(E2ROOT) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(E2ROOT,n)) and os.path.exists(os.path.join(E2ROOT,n,'load-repeat-summary.csv'))]
+    if candidates:E2=max(candidates,key=os.path.getmtime)
+E3=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e3-v2')
+E4=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e4-v2')
+E4C=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e4-v2-corrected')
+def read(path):
+    with open(path,newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f:return list(csv.DictReader(f))
+def save(fig,directory,name):
+    os.makedirs(directory,exist_ok=True)
+    for ext in ('png','pdf','svg'):fig.savefig(os.path.join(directory,f'{name}.{ext}'),dpi=180)
+
+e1run=read(os.path.join(E1,'summary.csv'))
+S11=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e1-v2-s11','summary.csv')
+if os.path.exists(S11):
+    s11rows=read(S11)
+    e1run=[r for r in e1run if r['scenario_id']!='S11']+[r for r in s11rows if r['scenario_id']=='S11']
+scenarios=list(dict.fromkeys(r['scenario_id'] for r in e1run if r['scenario_id']!='LEGITIMATE_CONTROL'))
+configs=list(dict.fromkeys(r['config_id'] for r in e1run if '-DEFAULT' not in r['config_id']))
+matrix=np.full((len(configs),len(scenarios)),np.nan)
+for r in e1run:
+    if r['config_id'] in configs and r['scenario_id'] in scenarios and r['attack_success_rate']!='':matrix[configs.index(r['config_id']),scenarios.index(r['scenario_id'])]=float(r['attack_success_rate'])
+fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(max(12,len(scenarios)*.85),max(6,len(configs)*.38)),constrained_layout=True)
+im=ax.imshow(matrix,vmin=0,vmax=1,cmap='YlOrRd',aspect='auto');ax.set_xticks(range(len(scenarios)),scenarios,rotation=35,ha='right');ax.set_yticks(range(len(configs)),configs);ax.set_xlabel('Scenario');ax.set_ylabel('Defense configuration');ax.set_title('E1 v2 attack success rate (SQLite ledger oracle)')
+for i in range(len(configs)):
+    for j in range(len(scenarios)):
+        if np.isfinite(matrix[i,j]):ax.text(j,i,f'{matrix[i,j]:.2f}',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=6)
+fig.colorbar(im,ax=ax,label='Debited / attempts');save(fig,E1,'attack-success-heatmap');plt.close(fig)
+tex=['\\begin{tabular}{l'+'c'*len(scenarios)+'}','\\toprule','Configuration & '+' & '.join(scenarios)+' \\\\','\\midrule']
+for i,c in enumerate(configs):tex.append(c+' & '+' & '.join('---' if not np.isfinite(matrix[i,j]) else f'{matrix[i,j]:.2f}' for j in range(len(scenarios)))+' \\\\')
+tex+=['\\bottomrule','\\end{tabular}'];open(os.path.join(E1,'coverage-matrix.tex'),'w',encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(tex)+'\n')
+if os.path.exists(S11):
+    with open(os.path.join(E1,'coverage-provenance.txt'),'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
+        import hashlib
+        for p in (os.path.join(E1,'summary.csv'),S11):
+            with open(p,'rb') as data:f.write(f"{os.path.relpath(p,ROOT)} sha256={hashlib.sha256(data.read()).hexdigest()}\n")
+
+if os.path.exists(os.path.join(E2,'load-repeat-summary.csv')):
+    rows=read(os.path.join(E2,'load-repeat-summary.csv'));stacks=[r['stack_id'] for r in rows];vals=[float(r['server_handler_repeat_median_median_ns'])/1e6 for r in rows];means=[(float(r['server_handler_t_ci95_low_ns'])+float(r['server_handler_t_ci95_high_ns']))/2e6 for r in rows];lo=[(float(r['server_handler_t_ci95_high_ns'])-float(r['server_handler_t_ci95_low_ns']))/2e6 for r in rows];
+    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,6),constrained_layout=True);x=np.arange(len(stacks));ax.bar(x,means,yerr=[lo,lo],capsize=3,label='Mean of repeat medians with t-based 95% CI');ax.scatter(x,vals,color='black',marker='D',zorder=3,label='Median of repeat medians');ax.set_xticks(x,stacks,rotation=30,ha='right');ax.set_ylabel('Server handler latency (ms)');ax.set_title('E2 v2 server-side handler cost');ax.legend();save(fig,E2,'server-handler-cost');plt.close(fig)
+    with open(os.path.join(E2,'load-summary.tex'),'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
+        f.write('\\begin{tabular}{lrrrr}\\toprule\nStack & Median of repeat medians (ns) & Mean t-CI low & Mean t-CI high & Repeats \\\\\n\\midrule\n')
+        for r in rows:f.write(f"{r['stack_id']} & {float(r['server_handler_repeat_median_median_ns']):.0f} & {float(r['server_handler_t_ci95_low_ns']):.0f} & {float(r['server_handler_t_ci95_high_ns']):.0f} & {r['repetitions']} \\\\\n")

diff --git a/experiments/run-f1-races.js b/experiments/run-f1-races.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..98acf5f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/experiments/run-f1-races.js
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+const { spawn } = require('child_process');
+const { timedRequest } = require('./lib/http');
+
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const runTag = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
+const output = path.join(__dirname, 'results', 'phase4-source-fixes', `race-session-final-${runTag}`);
+const serverOutput = path.join(output, 'server.stdout.log');
+const serverError = path.join(output, 'server.stderr.log');
+fs.mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true });
+
+function spawnLogged(script, cwd, env, stdoutPath, stderrPath) {
+  const stdout = fs.openSync(stdoutPath, 'a');
+  const stderr = fs.openSync(stderrPath, 'a');
+  const child = spawn(process.execPath, [script], { cwd, env, stdio: ['ignore', stdout, stderr], windowsHide: true });
+  child.once('exit', () => { fs.closeSync(stdout); fs.closeSync(stderr); });
+  return child;
+}
+function waitExit(child) {
+  return new Promise((resolve) => child.once('exit', (code, signal) => resolve({ code, signal })));
+}
+async function stop(child) {
+  if (!child || child.exitCode !== null) return;
+  child.kill();
+  await Promise.race([waitExit(child), new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000))]);
+  if (child.exitCode === null && child.pid && process.platform === 'win32') {
+    await new Promise((resolve) => {
+      const killer = spawn('taskkill', ['/PID', String(child.pid), '/T', '/F'], { stdio: 'ignore', windowsHide: true });
+      killer.once('exit', resolve);
+    });
+  }
+}
+async function waitHealth(child, port) {
+  const deadline = Date.now() + 30000;
+  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
+    if (child.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`Measured server exited early; inspect ${serverError}`);
+    try {
+      const response = await timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/health`);
+      if (response.status === 200) return;
+    } catch {}
+    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
+  }
+  throw new Error(`Measured server health timed out; inspect ${serverError}`);
+}
+
+async function main() {
+  const port = 3110;
+  const database = path.join(output, 'race-session.sqlite');
+  const baseEnvironment = {
+    ...process.env,
+    PORT: String(port), HOST: '127.0.0.1', VIZ_PORT: '3111', VIZ_ENABLED: 'false', DEMO_MODE: 'false',
+    LEGACY_SHARED_SECRET: 'false', ENABLE_DEMO_ROUTES: 'true',
+    DEFENSE_HMAC: 'true', DEFENSE_TIMESTAMP: 'true', DEFENSE_NONCE: 'true', DEFENSE_REQUEST_ID: 'true',
+    CHECK_ORDER: 'hmac,timestamp,nonce,request_id,balance',
+    TIMESTAMP_PAST_WINDOW_SECONDS: '300', TIMESTAMP_FUTURE_WINDOW_SECONDS: '5',
+    NONCE_BACKEND: 'redis', NONCE_TTL: '3600', NONCE_STORE_FAIL_MODE: 'fail-closed',
+    NONCE_KEY_NAMESPACE: `f1-race-${runTag}`, REDIS_URL: 'redis://127.0.0.1:6379',
+    SESSION_TTL: '3600', SQLITE_DB: database, EXPERIMENT_LOG: path.join(output, 'server-timings.csv'),
+    CONFIG_ID: 'F1-session-all-defenses', SCENARIO_ID: 'race', RUN_ID: runTag
+  };
+  const server = spawnLogged('server.js', path.join(root, 'server'), baseEnvironment, serverOutput, serverError);
+  try {
+    await waitHealth(server, port);
+    const raceEnvironment = {
+      ...baseEnvironment, EXPERIMENT_API: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`, RACE_DB_PATH: database,
+      RACE_BATCHES: '1000', RACE_OUTPUT: output
+    };
+    const runner = spawnLogged('run-races.js', __dirname, raceEnvironment, path.join(output, 'race-runner.stdout.log'), path.join(output, 'race-runner.stderr.log'));
+    const result = await waitExit(runner);
+    if (result.code !== 0) throw new Error(`Race runner failed with exit ${result.code} (${result.signal || 'no signal'}); inspect ${output}`);
+    process.stdout.write(`Session-mode F1 races completed. Raw output: ${output}\n`);
+  } finally {
+    await stop(server);
+  }
+}
+
+main().catch((error) => { process.stderr.write(`${error.stack || error.message}\n`); process.exitCode = 1; });
diff --git a/experiments/run-phase4.js b/experiments/run-phase4.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6a5766f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/experiments/run-phase4.js
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+const { spawnSync } = require('child_process');
+const path = require('path');
+
+const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
+const steps = [
+  [process.execPath, ['experiments/e1/run.js']],
+  [process.execPath, ['experiments/e1/finalize-oracle-summary.js']],
+  [process.execPath, ['experiments/e2/run.js']],
+  ['python', ['experiments/render-pack-a.py']],
+  [process.execPath, ['experiments/write-results-pack.js']]
+];
+
+for (const [command, args] of steps) {
+  const result = spawnSync(command, args, { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit', windowsHide: true });
+  if (result.error) throw result.error;
+  if (result.status !== 0) process.exit(result.status || 1);
+}

diff --git a/experiments/write-paper-facts.js b/experiments/write-paper-facts.js

index 0000000..f15c365
--- /dev/null
+++ b/experiments/write-paper-facts.js
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),crypto=require('crypto');
+const ROOT=path.resolve(__dirname,'..'),R=path.join(ROOT,'experiments/results'),OUT=path.join(ROOT,'docs/PAPER_FACTS.md');
+const sha=f=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(f)).digest('hex'),rel=f=>path.relative(ROOT,f).replace(/\\/g,'/');
+function walk(d){if(!fs.existsSync(d))return[];return fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>{const f=path.join(d,e.name);return e.isDirectory()?walk(f):[f];});}
+function parseCsv(text){const lines=text.trimEnd().split(/\r?\n/);const parse=s=>{let a=[],v='',q=false;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){let c=s[i];if(q&&c==='"'&&s[i+1]==='"'){v+='"';i++;}else if(c==='"')q=!q;else if(c===','&&!q){a.push(v);v='';}else v+=c;}a.push(v);return a;};const h=parse(lines[0]);return lines.slice(1).filter(Boolean).map(l=>Object.fromEntries(h.map((x,i)=>[x,parse(l)[i]||''])));}
+const rows=[];function unit(k){if(/delaySigma/i.test(k))return'dimensionless lognormal sigma';if(/_ns$|nanosecond/i.test(k))return'ns';if(/_ms$|millisecond/i.test(k))return'ms';if(/second|ttl|delay|offset|window/i.test(k))return's';if(/bytes|memory/i.test(k))return'bytes';if(/rate|ratio|probability/i.test(k))return'proportion';if(/cpu|mhz|frequency/i.test(k))return'MHz';return'count / source unit';}

+﻿const fs = require('fs');

+const crypto = require('crypto');

+const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');

+const sha256 = (file) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(file)).digest('hex');
+
+function parseCsv(text) {
+  const lines = text.trimEnd().split(/\r?\n/);
+  const parse = (line) => {
+    const values = []; let field = ''; let quoted = false;
+    for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i += 1) {
+      const ch = line[i];
+      if (quoted && ch === '"' && line[i + 1] === '"') { field += '"'; i += 1; }
+      else if (ch === '"') quoted = !quoted;
+      else if (ch === ',' && !quoted) { values.push(field); field = ''; }
+      else field += ch;
+    }
+    values.push(field); return values;
+  };
+  const headers = parse(lines[0]);
+  return { headers, rows: lines.slice(1).filter(Boolean).map((line) => Object.fromEntries(headers.map((header, index) => [header, parse(line)[index] ?? '']))) };
+}
+function stats(values) {
+  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
+  const pct = (p) => { const ix = (sorted.length - 1) * p; const lo = Math.floor(ix); const hi = Math.ceil(ix); return sorted[lo] + (sorted[hi] - sorted[lo]) * (ix - lo); };
+  return { count: values.length, min: sorted[0], max: sorted.at(-1), mean: values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length, p50: pct(.5), p95: pct(.95), p99: pct(.99) };
+}
+function csvFiles(directory) {
+  if (!fs.existsSync(directory)) return [];
+  const result = [];
+  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
+    const full = path.join(directory, entry.name);
+    if (entry.isDirectory()) result.push(...csvFiles(full));
+    else if (entry.isFile() && entry.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv')) result.push(full);
+  }
+  return result.sort();
+}
+function escapeCell(value) { return String(value).replace(/\|/g, '\\|').replace(/\r?\n/g, '<br>'); }
+function renderCsvSection(file) {
+  const text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
+  const parsed = parseCsv(text);
+  const relative = path.relative(ROOT, file).replace(/\\/g, '/');
+  const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(text);
+  const large = parsed.rows.length > 1000 || bytes > 200 * 1024;
+  const out = [`### \`${relative}\``, '', `- Size: ${bytes} bytes; SHA-256: \`${sha256(file)}\`; rows excluding header: ${parsed.rows.length}.`];
+  if (!large) {
+    out.push('', `Full table (${parsed.rows.length} rows):`, '', `| ${parsed.headers.join(' | ')} |`, `| ${parsed.headers.map(() => '---').join(' | ')} |`);
+    for (const row of parsed.rows) out.push(`| ${parsed.headers.map((key) => escapeCell(row[key])).join(' | ')} |`);
+    return out.join('\n');
+  }
+  out.push('- Large-file policy: only the first 20 data rows, last 20 data rows, and aggregate statistics are shown here. Full CSV stays on disk unchanged.');
+  for (const [label, rows] of [['First 20 rows', parsed.rows.slice(0, 20)], ['Last 20 rows', parsed.rows.slice(-20)]]) {
+    out.push('', `**${label}**`, '', `| ${parsed.headers.join(' | ')} |`, `| ${parsed.headers.map(() => '---').join(' | ')} |`);
+    for (const row of rows) out.push(`| ${parsed.headers.map((key) => escapeCell(row[key])).join(' | ')} |`);
+  }
+  // Accept only canonical decimal numeric fields. Number('deadbeef') can
+  // otherwise coerce hexadecimal-looking IDs/hashes in surprising ways.
+  const numericPattern = /^[-+]?(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?$/;
+  const numeric = parsed.headers.filter((key) => !/(?:hash|_?id$|token|signature|nonce|key)/i.test(key)).map((key) => [key, parsed.rows.map((row) => row[key]).filter((value) => value !== '' && numericPattern.test(String(value))).map(Number)]).filter(([, values]) => values.length);
+  out.push('', '**Aggregate statistics for numeric columns**', '', '| Column | count | min | max | mean | p50 | p95 | p99 |', '| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |');
+  for (const [key, values] of numeric) { const s = stats(values); out.push(`| ${key} | ${s.count} | ${s.min} | ${s.max} | ${s.mean} | ${s.p50} | ${s.p95} | ${s.p99} |`); }
+  const numericColumns = new Set(numeric.map(([key]) => key));
+  const categorical = parsed.headers.filter((key) => !numericColumns.has(key));
+  if (categorical.length) {
+    out.push('', '**Counts for categorical columns**', '');
+    for (const key of categorical) {
+      const counts = new Map();
+      for (const row of parsed.rows) counts.set(row[key], (counts.get(row[key]) || 0) + 1);
+      const ordered = [...counts.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0])));
+      out.push(`- \`${key}\`: ${counts.size} distinct values; total ${parsed.rows.length} rows; top counts: ${JSON.stringify(ordered.slice(0, 20))}.`);
+    }
+  }
+  return out.join('\n');
+}

The race issued ${identical.totalRequests} requests in ${identical.batches} batches of ${identical.parallelWidth}; accepted-count distribution was \`${JSON.stringify(identical.acceptedCountDistribution)}\`, balance-delta distribution was \`${JSON.stringify(identical.balanceDeltaDistribution)}\`, and the SQLite oracle found ${identical.moneyOracle.duplicateDebitCount} duplicate debit rows and ${identical.moneyOracle.unauthorizedDebitAmount} unauthorized debit amount.`,

+}

For every CSV larger than 200 KB or with more than 1,000 data rows, only the first 20 rows, last 20 rows, and aggregate statistics are included below. Smaller CSVs are included in full.`, '');

+for (const file of [...e1Inventory, ...e2Inventory, ...raceInventory]) lines.push(renderCsvSection(file), '');

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c57f377
--- /dev/null
+++ b/server/test/idempotency-policy.test.js
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+const test=require('node:test');const assert=require('node:assert/strict');const os=require('os');const path=require('path');const crypto=require('crypto');
+process.env.SQLITE_DB=path.join(os.tmpdir(),`cs-project-policy-${process.pid}-${crypto.randomUUID()}.sqlite`);process.env.NONCE_STORE='memory';process.env.VIZ_ENABLED='false';process.env.DEMO_MODE='false';process.env.LEGACY_SHARED_SECRET='false';process.env.HMAC_SECRET='policy-test-only-key';process.env.IDEMPOTENCY_POLICY='any_outcome';process.env.DEFENSE_HMAC='true';process.env.DEFENSE_TIMESTAMP='true';process.env.DEFENSE_NONCE='true';process.env.DEFENSE_REQUEST_ID='true';process.env.ENABLE_DEMO_ROUTES='false';
+const {app,db,redisClient,initializeDatabase}=require('../core');const {generateSignature}=require('../utils/hmac');let server,base,session;
+async function call(url,payload,token=session?.sessionToken){return fetch(`${base}${url}`,{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json',...(token?{authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}:{})},body:JSON.stringify(payload)});}
+function signed(requestId,nonce,amount=10,signature=true){const p={method:'POST',path:'/api/withdraw',user_id:'anis_101',account_id:'acc_777',amount,currency:'BDT',timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),nonce,request_id:requestId};if(signature)p.signature=generateSignature(p,session.sessionKey);return p;}
+test.before(async()=>{await initializeDatabase();await redisClient.connect();server=app.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await new Promise(r=>server.once('listening',r));base=`http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;const response=await call('/api/login',{user_id:'anis_101',pin:'1234'},null);session=await response.json();});
+test.after(async()=>{await new Promise(r=>server.close(r));await redisClient.quit();await new Promise(r=>db.close(r));});
+test('any_outcome policy blocks same-ID fresh-nonce retry after FAILED but permits a new ID',async()=>{await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>db.run("UPDATE accounts SET balance=1 WHERE user_id='anis_101'",e=>e?reject(e):resolve()));const first=await call('/api/withdraw',signed('failed-once','nonce-first',100));assert.equal((await first.json()).reason,'INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE');await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>db.run("UPDATE accounts SET balance=100 WHERE user_id='anis_101'",e=>e?reject(e):resolve()));const same=await call('/api/withdraw',signed('failed-once','nonce-fresh',10));assert.equal((await same.json()).reason,'ALREADY_PROCESSED');const newId=await call('/api/withdraw',signed('new-after-failure','nonce-new',10));assert.equal((await newId.json()).status,'ACCEPTED');});
+test('S11 token-only request without the session signature is rejected at HMAC',async()=>{const forged=signed('token-only-forgery','token-only-nonce',1,false);const response=await call('/api/withdraw',forged);const body=await response.json();assert.equal(body.reason,'SIGNATURE_FAIL',`HTTP ${response.status}: ${JSON.stringify(body)}`);});

diff --git a/server/test/proxy.test.js b/server/test/proxy.test.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..74de15a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/server/test/proxy.test.js
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+const test = require('node:test');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+const fs = require('fs');
+const http = require('http');
+const os = require('os');
+const path = require('path');
+const { spawn } = require('child_process');
+
+function listen(server) { return new Promise((resolve) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => resolve(server.address().port))); }
+function close(server) { return new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve)); }
+function chunkedPost(port, pathName, body) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const request = http.request({ hostname: '127.0.0.1', port, path: pathName, method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'transfer-encoding': 'chunked' } }, (response) => {
+      const chunks = [];
+      response.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));
+      response.on('end', () => resolve({ status: response.statusCode, body: Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8') }));
+    });
+    request.on('error', reject);
+    request.write(body.slice(0, 13));
+    request.end(body.slice(13));
+  });
+}
+
+test('proxy forwards login response unchanged but redacts attacker-visible login bodies', async () => {
+  const token = 'test-session-token-must-not-be-captured';
+  const key = 'test-session-key-must-not-be-captured';
+  const upstream = http.createServer((req, res) => {
+    res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'application/json' });
+    res.end(req.url === '/api/login' ? JSON.stringify({ sessionToken: token, sessionKey: key }) : JSON.stringify({ status: 'ok' }));
+  });
+  const upstreamPort = await listen(upstream);
+  const proxyPortServer = http.createServer();
+  const proxyPort = await listen(proxyPortServer);
+  await close(proxyPortServer);
+  const directory = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'proxy-redact-test-'));
+  const capture = path.join(directory, 'capture.json');
+  const child = spawn(process.execPath, [path.resolve(__dirname, '../../experiments/recording-proxy.js')], {
+    env: { ...process.env, PROXY_UPSTREAM: `http://127.0.0.1:${upstreamPort}`, PROXY_PORT: String(proxyPort), PROXY_CAPTURE_FILE: capture, PROXY_WITHDRAW_CAPTURE_FILE: `${capture}.withdraw.json`, PROXY_REDACT_LOGIN: 'true' },
+    stdio: 'ignore'
+  });
+  try {
+    let ready = false;
+    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 40; attempt += 1) {
+      try { await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${proxyPort}/api/health`); ready = true; break; } catch { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50)); }
+    }
+    assert.equal(ready, true, 'proxy process should start');
+    const response = await chunkedPost(proxyPort, '/api/login', '{"user_id":"u","pin":"1234"}');
+    const body = JSON.parse(response.body);
+    assert.equal(response.status, 200);
+    assert.deepEqual(body, { sessionToken: token, sessionKey: key });
+    const captureRecord = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(capture, 'utf8'));
+    assert.equal(captureRecord.response.body, '<REDACTED LOGIN RESPONSE>');
+    assert.equal(captureRecord.request.body, '<REDACTED LOGIN REQUEST>');
+    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(captureRecord).includes(token), false);
+    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(captureRecord).includes(key), false);
+    const jsonl = fs.readFileSync(`${capture}.jsonl`, 'utf8');
+    assert.equal(jsonl.includes(token), false);
+    assert.equal(jsonl.includes(key), false);
+  } finally {
+    child.kill();
+    await close(upstream);
+  }
+});

+const test = require('node:test');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+const { spawnSync } = require('child_process');
+const path = require('path');
+
+test('demo reset and nonce-crash routes are absent when ENABLE_DEMO_ROUTES=false', () => {
+  const code = `const {app,db}=require('./core'); const paths=app._router.stack.filter(x=>x.route).map(x=>x.route.path); const ok=!paths.includes('/api/reset')&&!paths.includes('/api/demo/nonce-crash'); db.close(()=>process.exit(ok?0:1));`;
+  const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['-e', code], {
+    cwd: path.resolve(__dirname, '..'),
+    encoding: 'utf8',
+    env: { ...process.env, ENABLE_DEMO_ROUTES: 'false', SQLITE_DB: path.join(require('os').tmpdir(), `route-gating-${process.pid}.sqlite`) }
+  });
+  assert.equal(result.status, 0, result.stderr || result.stdout);
+});
+
+test('test fault route is absent unless ENABLE_TEST_FAULT_ROUTE=true', () => {
+  const code = `const {app,db}=require('./core'); const paths=app._router.stack.filter(x=>x.route).map(x=>x.route.path); const ok=!paths.includes('/__test/fault/nonce-store')&&!paths.includes('/__test/profile/flush'); db.close(()=>process.exit(ok?0:1));`;
+  const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['-e', code], {
+    cwd: path.resolve(__dirname, '..'),
+    encoding: 'utf8',
+    env: { ...process.env, ENABLE_TEST_FAULT_ROUTE: 'false', SQLITE_DB: path.join(require('os').tmpdir(), `route-fault-gating-${process.pid}.sqlite`) }
+  });
+  assert.equal(result.status, 0, result.stderr || result.stdout);
+});
+
+test('event-loop profile flush route requires both the test route and profile flags', () => {
+  const code = `const {app,db}=require('./core'); const paths=app._router.stack.filter(x=>x.route).map(x=>x.route.path); const ok=paths.includes('/__test/profile/flush'); db.close(()=>process.exit(ok?0:1));`;
+  const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['-e', code], {
+    cwd: path.resolve(__dirname, '..'),
+    encoding: 'utf8',
+    env: { ...process.env, ENABLE_TEST_FAULT_ROUTE: 'true', EXPERIMENT_PROFILE: 'true', SQLITE_DB: path.join(require('os').tmpdir(), `route-profile-gating-${process.pid}.sqlite`) }
+  });
+  assert.equal(result.status, 0, result.stderr || result.stdout);
+});

diff --git a/server/utils/config-warnings.js b/server/utils/config-warnings.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5ca1128
--- /dev/null
+++ b/server/utils/config-warnings.js
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+function getStartupWarnings({ nonceTtl, pastWindow, futureWindow, host, enableDemoRoutes }) {
+  const warnings = [];
+  if (Number(nonceTtl) < Number(pastWindow) + Number(futureWindow)) {
+    warnings.push(`NONCE_TTL (${nonceTtl}s) is shorter than the combined timestamp window (${Number(pastWindow) + Number(futureWindow)}s).`);
+  }
+  if (host === '0.0.0.0' && enableDemoRoutes) {
+    warnings.push('ENABLE_DEMO_ROUTES is enabled while HOST=0.0.0.0; demo reset/crash routes are exposed on all interfaces.');
+  }
+  return warnings;
+}
+
+module.exports = { getStartupWarnings };

--- a/server/utils/nonce.js
+++ b/server/utils/nonce.js
@@ -20,7 +20,25 @@ function sqliteGet(db, sql, params = []) {
 }
 
+function sweepExpiredMemory(store, now = Date.now()) {
+  let removed = 0;
+  for (const [entry, expiresAt] of store) {
+    if (expiresAt <= now) { store.delete(entry); removed += 1; }
+  }
+  return removed;

+function validSignedRequest(payload, type) {
+  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return false;
+  const fields = ['method', 'path', 'user_id', 'account_id', 'currency', 'timestamp', 'nonce', 'request_id'];
+  if (fields.some((field) => typeof payload[field] !== 'string' || /[|\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(payload[field]))) return false;
+  return payload.method === 'POST'
+    && payload.path === `/api/${type.toLowerCase()}`
+    && payload.user_id.length > 0
+    && payload.account_id.length > 0
+    && payload.currency.length > 0
+    && payload.nonce.length > 0
+    && payload.request_id.length > 0
+    && Number.isSafeInteger(payload.amount)
+    && payload.amount > 0
+    && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(payload.timestamp));
+}
+
+module.exports = { validSignedRequest };

@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+function isTimestampWithinWindow(timestamp, checkedAtMs, pastWindowSeconds, futureWindowSeconds) {
+  const timestampMs = Date.parse(timestamp);
+  if (!Number.isFinite(timestampMs)) return false;
+  const ageSeconds = (checkedAtMs - timestampMs) / 1000;
+  return ageSeconds >= -futureWindowSeconds && ageSeconds <= pastWindowSeconds;
+}
+
+module.exports = { isTimestampWithinWindow };

## Outcomes

Headline result tables, raw CSV paths, hashes, and caveats are reproduced from `docs/RESULTS_PACK_A.md` below.

# Final Experiment Results Pack

Generated 2026-10-18T18:51:29.438Z. All traffic was directed to the localhost simulation on Windows with Memurai Developer 4.2.3. Latency numbers are localhost-only and support relative comparisons. No Phase 5 work was started.

## Methods and corrections

- E1/E1-S11 use session login, bearer tokens, per-session signing for legitimate traffic, a keep-alive HTTP agent, isolated SQLite databases, per-run Memurai namespaces, and VIZ disabled. “None” disables only the four replay layers; authentication and account ownership remain. S11 attacker requests contain only the captured bearer token and no signature.
- C2 compares `success_only` (default) and `any_outcome`; all other experiments use `success_only`. S10 fast/late each replay one captured FAILED request 30 times. C2 resubmission trials use 30 distinct failed requests per cell.
- E3 offsets and delays are simulation assumptions; they are not measured network distributions. Timestamp acceptance uses the same exported helper in `server/utils/timestamp.js` for server and E3 offline validation.
- E4c initial output and the reused-directory rerun are superseded. Cite only `experiments/results/e4-final-c3-rerun/e4c.csv`. E4b’s earlier one-replay-per-case output is superseded by the 30-trial rerun.
- Older E1 report field `oracle_total_debited_delta` is an amount, not a debit-row count. `debited_count` is the number of success rows. E1 S10 had one FAILED request ID replayed 30 times, which explains amounts greater than debit-row counts.

### S10 original delayed-execution rows

C0: each 30-attempt S10 replay batch replays one captured FAILED request; it has one distinct request ID and one nonce. The harness sets balance to 1, sends a 100-unit withdrawal, then funds with 500, making the balance 501. Five successful 100-unit withdrawals leave 1. Five ledger success rows for one request ID count as four extra duplicate rows (`5 - 1 = 4`). This is the saved E1 result, not a new run.
