const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),{spawn}=require('child_process'),crypto=require('crypto');
const {timedRequest}=require('../lib/http'),{generateSignature}=require('../../server/utils/hmac'),sqlite3=require('../../server/node_modules/sqlite3').verbose();
require('../../server/node_modules/dotenv').config({path:path.resolve(__dirname,'../../server/.env')});
const ROOT=path.resolve(__dirname,'../..'),OUT=path.resolve(process.env.POLICY_RETRY_OUTPUT||path.join(ROOT,'experiments/results/s10-policy-resubmit'));
function csv(v){v=String(v??'');return /[",\r\n]/.test(v)?`"${v.replace(/"/g,'""')}"`:v;}
function write(file,rows){const h=Object.keys(rows[0]);fs.writeFileSync(file,[h.join(','),...rows.map(r=>h.map(k=>csv(r[k])).join(','))].join('\n')+'\n');}
function wilson(k,n){const z=1.959963984540054,p=k/n,d=1+z*z/n,c=(p+z*z/(2*n))/d,m=z*Math.sqrt((p*(1-p)+z*z/(4*n))/n)/d;return[c-m,c+m];}
async function server(env,dir){const out=fs.openSync(path.join(dir,'server.stdout.log'),'a'),err=fs.openSync(path.join(dir,'server.stderr.log'),'a'),child=spawn(process.execPath,['server.js'],{cwd:path.join(ROOT,'server'),env,stdio:['ignore',out,err],windowsHide:true});child.once('exit',()=>{try{fs.closeSync(out)}catch{}try{fs.closeSync(err)}catch{}});for(let i=0;i<200;i++){if(child.exitCode!==null)throw Error(`server exited; see ${dir}`);try{if((await timedRequest('http://127.0.0.1:3600/api/health')).status===200)return child}catch{}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}throw Error(`health timeout ${dir}`);}
async function stop(p){if(!p||p.exitCode!==null)return;p.kill();await Promise.race([new Promise(r=>p.once('exit',r)),new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500))]);if(p.exitCode===null)spawn('taskkill',['/PID',String(p.pid),'/T','/F'],{stdio:'ignore',windowsHide:true});}
function dbRun(db,sql,args=[]){return new Promise((res,rej)=>db.run(sql,args,e=>e?rej(e):res()));}
function payload(s,id,nonce,pathName='/api/withdraw',amount=100){const p={method:'POST',path:pathName,user_id:'anis_101',account_id:'acc_777',amount,currency:'BDT',timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),nonce,request_id:id};p.signature=generateSignature(p,s.sessionKey);return p;}
async function post(p,s){return timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:3600${p.path}`,{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json',authorization:`Bearer ${s.sessionToken}`},body:JSON.stringify(p)});}
async function run(policy,variant){const id=`${policy}-${variant}`,dir=path.join(OUT,id);fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});const started=new Date(),env={...process.env,PORT:'3600',HOST:'127.0.0.1',VIZ_ENABLED:'false',DEMO_MODE:'false',LEGACY_SHARED_SECRET:'false',ENABLE_DEMO_ROUTES:'false',IDEMPOTENCY_POLICY:policy,NONCE_STORE:'redis',NONCE_TTL:'86400',REDIS_URL:'redis://127.0.0.1:6379',NONCE_KEY_NAMESPACE:`policy-${id}-${process.pid}`,SQLITE_DB:path.join(dir,'run.sqlite'),TIMESTAMP_PAST_WINDOW_SECONDS:'300',TIMESTAMP_FUTURE_WINDOW_SECONDS:'5',DEFENSE_HMAC:'true',DEFENSE_TIMESTAMP:'true',DEFENSE_NONCE:'true',DEFENSE_REQUEST_ID:'true',EXPERIMENT_LOG:path.join(dir,'server-timings.csv')};let child,session,db;const rows=[],reasons={};let successes=0;try{child=await server(env,dir);db=new sqlite3.Database(env.SQLITE_DB);session=(await timedRequest('http://127.0.0.1:3600/api/login',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({user_id:'anis_101',pin:process.env.DEMO_PIN||'1234'})})).body;
for(let i=0;i<30;i++){await dbRun(db,"UPDATE accounts SET balance=1 WHERE user_id='anis_101'");const reqId=`${id}-${i}`,bad=payload(session,reqId,`${id}-initial-${i}`),first=await post(bad,session);if(first.body.reason!=='INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE')throw Error(`expected insufficient balance, got ${first.body.reason}`);const dep=payload(session,`${id}-fund-${i}`,`${id}-fund-n-${i}`,'/api/deposit',100),fund=await post(dep,session);if(fund.status!==200)throw Error(`fund failed ${fund.status}/${fund.body.error}`);const retryId=variant==='same_request_id_fresh_nonce'?reqId:`${reqId}-new`,retry=payload(session,retryId,`${id}-retry-${i}`),response=await post(retry,session),reason=response.body.reason||response.body.status||response.body.error||`HTTP_${response.status}`;reasons[reason]=(reasons[reason]||0)+1;if(response.status===200&&response.body.status==='ACCEPTED')successes++;rows.push({trial:i+1,policy,variant,initial_status:first.status,initial_reason:first.body.reason,retry_request_id_relation:variant==='same_request_id_fresh_nonce'?'same':'new',retry_status:response.status,retry_reason:reason,debited:response.status===200&&response.body.status==='ACCEPTED'?1:0,first_start_ns:first.start_ns,first_end_ns:first.end_ns,fund_start_ns:fund.start_ns,fund_end_ns:fund.end_ns,retry_start_ns:response.start_ns,retry_end_ns:response.end_ns});}
}finally{if(db)await new Promise(r=>db.close(()=>r()));await stop(child);}
const ci=wilson(successes,30);return {rows,summary:{policy,variant,attempts:30,successes,failures:30-successes,success_rate:successes/30,wilson95_low:ci[0],wilson95_high:ci[1],reason_histogram:JSON.stringify(reasons),started:started.toISOString(),ended:new Date().toISOString()}};}
async function main(){fs.mkdirSync(OUT,{recursive:true});const started=new Date(),all=[],summary=[];for(const policy of ['success_only','any_outcome'])for(const variant of ['same_request_id_fresh_nonce','new_request_id_fresh_nonce']){const result=await run(policy,variant);all.push(...result.rows);summary.push(result.summary);}write(path.join(OUT,'requests.csv'),all);write(path.join(OUT,'summary.csv'),summary);fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT,'run.json'),JSON.stringify({started:started.toISOString(),ended:new Date().toISOString(),elapsedSeconds:(Date.now()-started.getTime())/1000,cellCount:4,trialsPerCell:30,requestIdDefense:true,localhostOnly:true,policySwitch:'IDEMPOTENCY_POLICY',keepAliveHttpAgent:true},null,2)+'\n');}
main().catch(e=>{process.stderr.write(`${e.stack||e.message}\n`);process.exitCode=1;});

const SESSION_TTL = 15;
const PIN = process.env.DEMO_PIN || '1234';
fs.mkdirSync(OUTPUT, { recursive: true });

const csv = (value) => {
  const text = value === undefined || value === null ? '' : String(value);
  return /[",\r\n]/.test(text) ? `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : text;
};
const writeCsv = (file, headers, rows) => fs.writeFileSync(file, `${[headers.join(','), ...rows.map((row) => headers.map((key) => csv(row[key])).join(','))].join('\n')}\n`);
const wilson = (successes, n) => {
  if (!n) return [0, 1];
  const z = 1.959963984540054;
  const p = successes / n;
  const d = 1 + z * z / n;
  const center = (p + z * z / (2 * n)) / d;
  const margin = z * Math.sqrt((p * (1 - p) + z * z / (4 * n)) / n) / d;
  return [Math.max(0, center - margin), Math.min(1, center + margin)];
};
const shortHash = (value) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(String(value)).digest('hex').slice(0, 12);
let deterministicSequence = 0;
const deterministicId = (scope) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${RANDOM_SEED}|${scope}|${deterministicSequence++}`).digest('hex').slice(0, 32);

async function waitHealth(port, child, log) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + 30000;
  const rows = [];
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (child.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`Server exited early; see ${log}`);
    try {
      const response = await timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/health`);
      rows.push({ start_ns: response.start_ns, end_ns: response.end_ns, duration_ns: response.duration_ns, http_status: response.status, outcome: response.status === 200 ? 'READY' : 'NOT_READY' });
      if (response.status === 200) { writeCsv(path.join(path.dirname(log), 'health-readiness.csv'), Object.keys(rows[0]), rows); return; }
    } catch (error) { rows.push({ start_ns: error.start_ns, end_ns: error.end_ns, duration_ns: error.duration_ns, http_status: '', outcome: 'CONNECT_ERROR' }); }
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
  }
  if (rows.length) writeCsv(path.join(path.dirname(log), 'health-readiness.csv'), Object.keys(rows[0]), rows);
  throw new Error(`Server health timed out; see ${log}`);
}

function spawnLogged(exe, args, options, stdout, stderr) {
  const out = fs.openSync(stdout, 'a');
  const err = fs.openSync(stderr, 'a');
  const child = spawn(exe, args, { ...options, stdio: ['ignore', out, err], windowsHide: true });
  child.once('exit', () => { try { fs.closeSync(out); } catch {} try { fs.closeSync(err); } catch {} });
  return child;
}

async function stop(child) {
  if (!child || child.exitCode !== null) return;
  child.kill();
  await Promise.race([new Promise((resolve) => child.once('exit', resolve)), new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 3000))]);
  if (child.exitCode === null && child.pid) spawn('taskkill', ['/PID', String(child.pid), '/T', '/F'], { stdio: 'ignore', windowsHide: true });
}

function parseCaptures(logPath) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(logPath)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).map((line) => JSON.parse(line));
}

async function runConfiguration(mask, profile = {}) {
  const past = profile.past ?? PAST;
  const future = profile.future ?? FUTURE;
  const nonceTtl = profile.nonceTtl ?? NONCE_TTL;
  const sessionTtl = profile.sessionTtl ?? SESSION_TTL;
  const policy = profile.idempotencyPolicy || process.env.IDEMPOTENCY_POLICY || 'success_only';
  const id = `H${mask & 1 ? 1 : 0}T${mask & 2 ? 1 : 0}N${mask & 4 ? 1 : 0}R${mask & 8 ? 1 : 0}${profile.suffix || ''}`;
  const port = 3200;
  const vizPort = 3201;
  const proxyPort = 3202;
  const namespace = `e1-${id.toLowerCase()}-${process.pid}`;
  const runDir = path.join(RUN_OUTPUT, id);
  fs.mkdirSync(runDir, { recursive: true });
  const captureBase = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `cs-e1-${id}-${process.pid}.json`);
  const captureLog = `${captureBase}.jsonl`;
  const serverEnv = {
    ...process.env,
    PORT: String(port), HOST: '127.0.0.1', VIZ_PORT: String(vizPort),
    VIZ_ENABLED: 'false', DEMO_MODE: 'false', LEGACY_SHARED_SECRET: 'false',
    ENABLE_DEMO_ROUTES: 'true', NONCE_STORE: 'redis', NONCE_TTL: String(nonceTtl),
    REDIS_URL: 'redis://127.0.0.1:6379',
    NONCE_KEY_NAMESPACE: namespace, SQLITE_DB: path.join(RUN_OUTPUT, `${id}.sqlite`),
    TIMESTAMP_PAST_WINDOW_SECONDS: String(past), TIMESTAMP_FUTURE_WINDOW_SECONDS: String(future), SESSION_TTL: String(sessionTtl),
    DEFENSE_HMAC: String(Boolean(mask & 1)), DEFENSE_TIMESTAMP: String(Boolean(mask & 2)),
    DEFENSE_NONCE: String(Boolean(mask & 4)), DEFENSE_REQUEST_ID: String(Boolean(mask & 8)),
    IDEMPOTENCY_POLICY: policy,
    EXPERIMENT_LOG: path.join(runDir, 'server-timings.csv'), CONFIG_ID: id, SCENARIO_ID: 'e1', RUN_ID: `e1-${Date.now()}`
  };
  const server = spawnLogged(process.execPath, ['server.js'], { cwd: SERVER, env: serverEnv }, path.join(runDir, 'server.stdout.log'), path.join(runDir, 'server.stderr.log'));
  const proxyEnv = { ...process.env, PROXY_UPSTREAM: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`, PROXY_PORT: String(proxyPort), PROXY_CAPTURE_FILE: captureBase, PROXY_WITHDRAW_CAPTURE_FILE: `${captureBase}.withdraw.json`, PROXY_REDACT_LOGIN: 'true' };
  let proxy;
  const requestRows = [];
  const summaries = [];
  let session = null;
  let ledgerDb = null;
  let sequence = 0;

  async function startProxy() {
    proxy = spawnLogged(process.execPath, [path.join(ROOT, 'experiments/recording-proxy.js')], { cwd: ROOT, env: proxyEnv }, path.join(runDir, 'proxy.stdout.log'), path.join(runDir, 'proxy.stderr.log'));
    const deadline = Date.now() + 10000;
    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
      if (proxy.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`Proxy exited; see ${runDir}`);
      try { await timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${proxyPort}/api/health`); return; } catch {}
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
    }
    throw new Error(`Proxy health timed out: ${runDir}`);
  }

  async function login() {
    const result = await timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${proxyPort}/api/login`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ user_id: 'anis_101', pin: PIN }) });
    if (result.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Session login failed with HTTP ${result.status}`);
    session = result.body;
  }

  function signedPayload({ requestId = `e1-${deterministicId(id)}`, nonce = `n-${deterministicId(id)}`, amount = 1 } = {}, signingKey = session.sessionKey) {
    const payload = { method: 'POST', path: '/api/withdraw', user_id: 'anis_101', account_id: 'acc_777', amount, currency: 'BDT', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), nonce, request_id: requestId };
    payload.signature = generateSignature(payload, signingKey);
    return payload;
  }

  async function submit(payload, token = session.sessionToken) {
    return timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${proxyPort}/api/withdraw`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
  }

  function findCapture(requestId) {
    const record = parseCaptures(captureLog).reverse().find((entry) => {
      if (entry.request.method !== 'POST' || new URL(entry.request.path, 'http://localhost').pathname !== '/api/withdraw') return false;
      try { return JSON.parse(entry.request.body).request_id === requestId; } catch { return false; }
    });
    if (!record) throw new Error(`Attacker-visible proxy capture missing for request ${shortHash(requestId)}`);
    return record;
  }

  async function replay(capture, mutate = (body) => body) {
    const body = mutate(JSON.parse(capture.request.body));
    const headers = { 'content-type': 'application/json' };
    const authorization = capture.request.headers.authorization;
    if (authorization) headers.authorization = authorization;
    return timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${proxyPort}/api/withdraw`, { method: 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  }

  async function ledger() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => ledgerDb.all('SELECT id, request_id, type, status, amount FROM transactions ORDER BY id', [], (error, rows) => error ? reject(error) : resolve(rows)));
  }

  async function baseline(label, count, addAuthorization = true) {
    const captures = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
      const payload = signedPayload();
      const response = await submit(payload);
      if (response.status !== 200 || response.body.status !== 'ACCEPTED') throw new Error(`${id}/${label}: baseline rejected (${response.status}/${response.body.reason || response.body.error})`);
      if (addAuthorization) authorized.push({ request_id: payload.request_id, amount: payload.amount, type: 'WITHDRAW' });
      captures.push(findCapture(payload.request_id));
      requestRows.push({ config_id: id, scenario_id: label, variant: '', attempt: i + 1, phase: 'legitimate', request_id_hash: shortHash(payload.request_id), start_ns: response.start_ns, end_ns: response.end_ns, duration_ns: response.duration_ns, http_status: response.status, outcome: response.body.status, reason: '' });
    }
    return captures;
  }

  const authorized = [];

  async function measureScenario(name, attempts, action, options = {}) {
    const beforeLedger = await ledger();
    const beforeRows = beforeLedger.filter((row) => row.status === 'SUCCESS' && row.type === 'WITHDRAW').length;
    const beforeOracle = computeMoneyIntegrity(beforeLedger, authorized);
    const results = await action();
    const afterLedger = await ledger();
    const afterRows = afterLedger.filter((row) => row.status === 'SUCCESS' && row.type === 'WITHDRAW').length;
    const afterOracle = computeMoneyIntegrity(afterLedger, authorized);
    const debited = afterRows - beforeRows;
    const accepted = results.filter((r) => r.status === 200 && r.body.status === 'ACCEPTED').length;
    const duplicateDelta = afterOracle.duplicate_debit_count - beforeOracle.duplicate_debit_count;
    const duplicateAmountDelta = afterOracle.duplicate_debit_amount - beforeOracle.duplicate_debit_amount;
    const unauthorizedDelta = afterOracle.unauthorized_debit_amount - beforeOracle.unauthorized_debit_amount;
    const reasons = {};
    results.forEach((r) => { const reason = r.body.reason || r.body.error || r.body.status || `HTTP_${r.status}`; reasons[reason] = (reasons[reason] || 0) + 1; });
    const interval = wilson(debited, attempts);
    summaries.push({ config_id: id, scenario_id: name, variant: options.variant || '', attempts, http_accepted_count: accepted, debited_count: debited, attack_success_rate: attempts ? debited / attempts : 0, wilson95_low: interval[0], wilson95_high: interval[1], blocking_reason_histogram: JSON.stringify(reasons), oracle_total_debited_delta: afterOracle.total_debited - beforeOracle.total_debited, oracle_duplicate_debit_count_delta: duplicateDelta, oracle_duplicate_debit_amount_delta: duplicateAmountDelta, oracle_unauthorized_debit_amount_delta: unauthorizedDelta, oracle_delayed_execution_count_delta: afterOracle.delayed_execution_count - beforeOracle.delayed_execution_count, oracle_delayed_execution_amount_delta: afterOracle.delayed_execution_amount - beforeOracle.delayed_execution_amount, oracle_integrity_holds: duplicateDelta === 0 && unauthorizedDelta === 0 });
    return results;
  }

  function recordAttempts(label, results, startIndex = 0, variant = '') {
    results.forEach((response, index) => {
      requestRows.push({ config_id: id, scenario_id: label, variant, attempt: startIndex + index + 1, phase: 'attacker', request_id_hash: '', start_ns: response.start_ns, end_ns: response.end_ns, duration_ns: response.duration_ns, http_status: response.status, outcome: response.body.status || 'REJECTED', reason: response.body.reason || response.body.error || '' });
    });
  }

  try {
    await waitHealth(port, server, path.join(runDir, 'server.stderr.log'));
    ledgerDb = new sqlite3.Database(serverEnv.SQLITE_DB);
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => ledgerDb.once('open', resolve).once('error', reject));
    await startProxy();
    await login();
    await baseline('LEGITIMATE_CONTROL', 30);
    summaries.push({ config_id: id, scenario_id: 'LEGITIMATE_CONTROL', attempts: 30, http_accepted_count: 30, debited_count: 30, attack_success_rate: null, wilson95_low: null, wilson95_high: null, blocking_reason_histogram: '{}', oracle_duplicate_debit_count_delta: 0, oracle_duplicate_debit_amount_delta: 0, oracle_unauthorized_debit_amount_delta: 0, oracle_integrity_holds: true });

    if (profile.fullScale) {
      for (const scenario of ['S2', 'S4']) {
        await login();
        const captures = await baseline(`${scenario}_legitimate_seed`, WIDTH);
        const waitSeconds = scenario === 'S2' ? 60 : 301;
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, waitSeconds * 1000));
        const results = await measureScenario(`${scenario}_default_window_${waitSeconds}s`, WIDTH, async () => Promise.all(captures.map((capture) => replay(capture))));
        recordAttempts(`${scenario}_default_window_${waitSeconds}s`, results);
      }
      writeCsv(path.join(runDir, 'requests.csv'), ['config_id', 'scenario_id', 'variant', 'attempt', 'phase', 'request_id_hash', 'start_ns', 'end_ns', 'duration_ns', 'http_status', 'outcome', 'reason'], requestRows);
      return summaries;
    }

    const filter = process.env.E1_SCENARIO_FILTER || '';
    const selectedScenarios = filter ? [filter] : ['S1', 'S2', 'S3', 'S4', 'S5', 'S6', 'S7a', 'S7b', 'S8', 'S9', 'S10_fast', 'S10_late'];
    for (const scenario of selectedScenarios) {
      await login();
      if (scenario === 'S1' || scenario === 'S2' || scenario === 'S3' || scenario === 'S4' || scenario === 'S8') {
        const captures = await baseline(`${scenario}_legitimate_seed`, WIDTH);
        if (scenario === 'S2') await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
        if (scenario === 'S3') await timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${proxyPort}/api/demo/nonce-crash`, { method: 'POST', headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${session.sessionToken}` }, body: '{}' });
        if (scenario === 'S4') await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, (past + 1) * 1000));
        if (scenario === 'S8') await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, (sessionTtl + 1) * 1000));
        const results = await measureScenario(scenario, WIDTH, async () => Promise.all(captures.map((capture) => replay(capture))));
        recordAttempts(scenario, results);
      } else if (scenario === 'S5') {
        const allResults = [];
        for (let batch = 0; batch < WIDTH; batch += 1) {
          await login();
          const [capture] = await baseline(`${scenario}_legitimate_seed`, 1);
          const results = await measureScenario(scenario, 50, async () => Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => replay(capture))));
          recordAttempts(scenario, results, batch * 50);
          allResults.push(results);
        }
        const group = summaries.filter((row) => row.config_id === id && row.scenario_id === scenario);
        const attempts = group.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.attempts, 0);
        const debited = group.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.debited_count, 0);
        const accepted = group.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.http_accepted_count, 0);
        const interval = wilson(debited, attempts);
        const reasonHistogram = {};
        for (const results of allResults) for (const response of results) { const reason = response.body.reason || response.body.error || response.body.status || `HTTP_${response.status}`; reasonHistogram[reason] = (reasonHistogram[reason] || 0) + 1; }
        const duplicateDelta = group.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.oracle_duplicate_debit_count_delta, 0);
        const unauthorizedDelta = group.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.oracle_unauthorized_debit_amount_delta, 0);
        summaries.splice(summaries.length - group.length, group.length, { config_id: id, scenario_id: scenario, attempts, http_accepted_count: accepted, debited_count: debited, attack_success_rate: debited / attempts, wilson95_low: interval ? interval[0] : null, wilson95_high: interval ? interval[1] : null, blocking_reason_histogram: JSON.stringify(reasonHistogram), oracle_duplicate_debit_count_delta: duplicateDelta, oracle_duplicate_debit_amount_delta: group.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.oracle_duplicate_debit_amount_delta, 0), oracle_unauthorized_debit_amount_delta: unauthorizedDelta, oracle_integrity_holds: duplicateDelta === 0 && unauthorizedDelta === 0 });
        continue;
      } else if (scenario === 'S6') {
        const captures = await baseline(`${scenario}_legitimate_seed`, WIDTH);
        const results = await measureScenario(scenario, WIDTH, async () => Promise.all(captures.map((capture) => replay(capture, (body) => ({ ...body, amount: body.amount + 1 })))));
        recordAttempts(scenario, results);
      } else if (scenario === 'S7a' || scenario === 'S7b') {
        const captures = await baseline(`${scenario}_legitimate_seed`, WIDTH);
        const field = scenario === 'S7a' ? 'request_id' : 'nonce';
        const results = await measureScenario(scenario, WIDTH, async () => Promise.all(captures.map((capture) => replay(capture, (body) => ({ ...body, [field]: `${body[field]}-changed` })))), { variant: field });
        recordAttempts(scenario, results, 0, field);
      } else if (scenario === 'S9') {
        const [seedCapture] = await baseline('S9_leaked_key_seed', 1);
        const bearer = seedCapture.request.headers.authorization.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
        const leakedKey = session.sessionKey;
        const payloads = Array.from({ length: WIDTH }, () => signedPayload({}, leakedKey));
        const results = await measureScenario(scenario, WIDTH, async () => Promise.all(payloads.map((payload) => submit(payload, bearer))));
        recordAttempts(scenario, results);
      } else if (scenario === 'S11') {
        const [tokenCapture] = await baseline('S11_token_capture_seed', 1);
        const bearer = tokenCapture.request.headers.authorization.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
        // The attacker gets only the bearer token. No session key is read or used here.
        const forged = Array.from({ length: WIDTH }, () => ({
          method: 'POST', path: '/api/withdraw', user_id: 'anis_101', account_id: 'acc_777', amount: 1,
          currency: 'BDT', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), nonce: `s11-n-${deterministicId(id)}`,
          request_id: `s11-r-${deterministicId(id)}`
        }));
        const results = await measureScenario(scenario, WIDTH, async () => Promise.all(forged.map((payload) => submit(payload, bearer))));
        recordAttempts(scenario, results);
      } else if (scenario === 'S10_fast' || scenario === 'S10_late') {
        const deposit = async (amount) => {
          const payload = { method: 'POST', path: '/api/deposit', user_id: 'anis_101', account_id: 'acc_777', amount, currency: 'BDT', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), nonce: `deposit-${deterministicId(id)}`, request_id: `fund-${deterministicId(id)}` };
          payload.signature = generateSignature(payload, session.sessionKey);
          return timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${proxyPort}/api/deposit`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', authorization: `Bearer ${session.sessionToken}` }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        };
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => ledgerDb.run("UPDATE accounts SET balance=1 WHERE user_id='anis_101'", (error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
        const failedPayload = signedPayload({ requestId: `s10-${deterministicId(id)}`, amount: 100 });
        authorized.push({ request_id: failedPayload.request_id, amount: failedPayload.amount, type: 'WITHDRAW' });
        const failedResponse = await submit(failedPayload);
        if (failedResponse.body.reason !== 'INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE') throw new Error(`${id}/${scenario}: expected INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, got ${failedResponse.body.reason || failedResponse.body.error}`);
        const capturedFailure = findCapture(failedPayload.request_id);
        const funded = await deposit(500);
        if (funded.status !== 200) throw new Error(`${id}/${scenario}: legitimate funding failed (${funded.status})`);
        if (scenario === 'S10_fast') await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
        else await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 7000));
        const results = await measureScenario(scenario, WIDTH, async () => Promise.all(Array.from({ length: WIDTH }, () => replay(capturedFailure))));
        recordAttempts(scenario, results);
      }
    }

    const rawHeaders = ['config_id', 'scenario_id', 'variant', 'attempt', 'phase', 'request_id_hash', 'start_ns', 'end_ns', 'duration_ns', 'http_status', 'outcome', 'reason'];
    writeCsv(path.join(runDir, 'requests.csv'), rawHeaders, requestRows);
  } finally {
    const proxyRows = parseCaptures(captureLog).map((entry) => ({ path: entry.request.path, method: entry.request.method, start_ns: entry.start_ns, end_ns: entry.end_ns, duration_ns: entry.duration_ns, http_status: entry.response.statusCode }));
    if (proxyRows.length) writeCsv(path.join(runDir, 'proxy-request-timings.csv'), Object.keys(proxyRows[0]), proxyRows);
    if (ledgerDb) await new Promise((resolve) => ledgerDb.close(() => resolve()));
    await stop(proxy);
    await stop(server);
  }
  return summaries;
}

async function main() {
  fs.mkdirSync(RUN_OUTPUT, { recursive: true });
  const started = new Date().toISOString();
  const allSummaries = [];
  const filter = process.env.E1_SCENARIO_FILTER || '';
  const onlyS11 = filter === 'S11';
  const policySweep = process.env.E1_POLICY_SWEEP === 'true';
  if (policySweep) {
    for (const policy of ['success_only', 'any_outcome']) {
      for (let mask = 8; mask < 16; mask += 1) {
        process.stdout.write(`Policy ${policy}, config mask ${mask}, scenario ${filter}\n`);
        allSummaries.push(...await runConfiguration(mask, { suffix: `-${policy}`, idempotencyPolicy: policy }));
      }
    }
  } else for (let mask = 0; mask < 16; mask += 1) {
    process.stdout.write(`E1 ${mask + 1}/16: defense mask ${mask}\n`);
    allSummaries.push(...await runConfiguration(mask));
  }
  if (!onlyS11 && !policySweep) {
    process.stdout.write('E1 default-window confirmation: S2/60s and S4/301s\n');
    allSummaries.push(...await runConfiguration(15, { suffix: '-DEFAULT', past: 300, future: 5, nonceTtl: 86400, sessionTtl: 900, fullScale: true }));
  }
  const headers = ['config_id', 'scenario_id', 'variant', 'attempts', 'http_accepted_count', 'debited_count', 'attack_success_rate', 'wilson95_low', 'wilson95_high', 'blocking_reason_histogram', 'oracle_total_debited_delta', 'oracle_duplicate_debit_count_delta', 'oracle_duplicate_debit_amount_delta', 'oracle_unauthorized_debit_amount_delta', 'oracle_delayed_execution_count_delta', 'oracle_delayed_execution_amount_delta', 'oracle_integrity_holds'];
  writeCsv(path.join(RUN_OUTPUT, 'summary.csv'), headers, allSummaries);
  const configs = [...new Set(allSummaries.map((r) => r.config_id))];
  const scenarios = [...new Set(allSummaries.filter((r) => r.scenario_id !== 'LEGITIMATE_CONTROL').map((r) => r.scenario_id))];
  const latex = ['\\begin{tabular}{llrrrrl}', '\\toprule', 'Configuration & Scenario & Attempts & Accepted & Debits & Success rate & Wilson 95\\% CI \\\\', '\\midrule', ...allSummaries.filter((r) => r.scenario_id !== 'LEGITIMATE_CONTROL').map((r) => `${r.config_id} & ${r.scenario_id} & ${r.attempts} & ${r.http_accepted_count} & ${r.debited_count} & ${(100 * r.attack_success_rate).toFixed(2)}\\% & ${r.wilson95_low.toFixed(4)}--${r.wilson95_high.toFixed(4)} \\\\`), '\\bottomrule', '\\end{tabular}', ''];
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(RUN_OUTPUT, 'summary.tex'), latex.join('\n'));
  const runMetadata = { started, ended: new Date().toISOString(), elapsedSeconds: (Date.now() - Date.parse(started)) / 1000, nodeVersion: process.version, host: { platform: os.platform(), release: os.release(), architecture: process.arch, cpuModel: os.cpus()[0]?.model, totalRamBytes: os.totalmem() }, dataRunDirectory: path.relative(OUTPUT, RUN_OUTPUT).replace(/\\/g, '/'), randomSeed: RANDOM_SEED, randomSeedScope: 'deterministic scenario request IDs and nonces; server session credentials use the operating-system CSPRNG', scaledProfile: { timestampPastSeconds: PAST, timestampFutureSeconds: FUTURE, nonceTtlSeconds: NONCE_TTL, sessionTtlSeconds: SESSION_TTL }, defaultConfirmationProfile: { timestampPastSeconds: 300, futureToleranceSeconds: 5, nonceTtlSeconds: 86400, sessionTtlSeconds: 900, waits: { S2: 60, S4: 301 } }, keepAliveHttpAgent: true, proxyRedactLogin: true, moneyOracleLedgerSource: 'direct sqlite3 SELECT from the running server database after each scenario', allConfigs: 16, totalSummaryRows: allSummaries.length, scenarios: scenarios.length, allSummaries };

    cellRows.push(report);
    layerRows.push(...layers.map((row) => ({ ...row, concurrency: Number(row.concurrency), repeat: Number(row.repeat), numeric_samples: Number(row.numeric_samples), disabled_count: Number(row.disabled_count), not_reached_count: Number(row.not_reached_count), p50_ns: row.p50_ns === '' ? const http = require('http');
const https = require('https');
const agents = { 'http:': new http.Agent({ keepAlive: true }), 'https:': new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true }) };

function timedRequest(input, options = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const url = new URL(input);
    const start = process.hrtime.bigint();
    const request = (url.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http).request(url, {
      method: options.method || 'GET',
      headers: options.headers || {},
      agent: agents[url.protocol]
    }, (response) => {
      const chunks = [];
      response.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));
      response.on('end', () => {
        const end = process.hrtime.bigint();
        const text = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
        let body;
        try { body = JSON.parse(text); } catch { body = text; }
        resolve({ start_ns: start.toString(), end_ns: end.toString(), duration_ns: (end - start).toString(), status: response.statusCode, headers: response.headers, body });
      });
    });
    request.on('error', (error) => {
      const end = process.hrtime.bigint();
      error.start_ns = start.toString();
      error.end_ns = end.toString();
      error.duration_ns = (end - start).toString();
      reject(error);
    });
    if (options.body !== undefined) request.write(options.body);
    request.end();
  });
}

module.exports = { timedRequest, keepAlive: true, agents };

const fs = require('fs');
const http = require('http');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

const upstream = new URL(process.env.PROXY_UPSTREAM || 'http://127.0.0.1:3000');
if (!['127.0.0.1', 'localhost'].includes(upstream.hostname)) throw new Error('Recording proxy only permits a localhost upstream');
const port = Number(process.env.PROXY_PORT || 3002);
const outputPath = process.env.PROXY_CAPTURE_FILE || path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'cs-project-onpath-capture.json');
const captureLogPath = `${outputPath}.jsonl`;
const withdrawalCapturePath = process.env.PROXY_WITHDRAW_CAPTURE_FILE || `${outputPath}.withdraw.json`;
const redactLogin = /^(1|true|yes|on)$/i.test(process.env.PROXY_REDACT_LOGIN || 'false');
const upstreamAgent = new http.Agent({ keepAlive: true });

const server = http.createServer((request, response) => {
  const started = process.hrtime.bigint();
  const chunks = [];
  request.on('data', (chunk) => chunks.push(chunk));
  request.on('end', () => {
    const bodyBuffer = Buffer.concat(chunks);
    const headers = { ...request.headers };
    delete headers.host;
    delete headers['content-length'];
    delete headers['transfer-encoding'];
    const proxyRequest = http.request({
      hostname: upstream.hostname,
      port: Number(upstream.port || 80),
      method: request.method,
      path: request.url,
      headers: { ...headers, 'content-length': bodyBuffer.length },
      agent: upstreamAgent
    }, (upstreamResponse) => {
      const responseChunks = [];
      upstreamResponse.on('data', (chunk) => responseChunks.push(chunk));
      upstreamResponse.on('end', () => {
        const responseBody = Buffer.concat(responseChunks);
        const ended = process.hrtime.bigint();
        const isLogin = request.method === 'POST' && new URL(request.url, upstream).pathname === '/api/login';
        const redact = redactLogin && isLogin;
        const record = {
          capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          start_ns: started.toString(),
          end_ns: ended.toString(),
          duration_ns: (ended - started).toString(),
          request: {
            method: request.method,
            path: request.url,
            headers: request.headers,
            body: redact ? '<REDACTED LOGIN REQUEST>' : bodyBuffer.toString('utf8')
          },
          response: { statusCode: upstreamResponse.statusCode, body: redact ? '<REDACTED LOGIN RESPONSE>' : responseBody.toString('utf8') }
        };
        fs.appendFileSync(captureLogPath, `${JSON.stringify(record)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
        const tempPath = `${outputPath}.${process.pid}.tmp`;
        fs.writeFileSync(tempPath, `${JSON.stringify(record, null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
        fs.renameSync(tempPath, outputPath);
        if (request.method === 'POST' && new URL(request.url, upstream).pathname === '/api/withdraw') {
          const withdrawalTempPath = `${withdrawalCapturePath}.${process.pid}.tmp`;
          fs.writeFileSync(withdrawalTempPath, `${JSON.stringify(record, null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
          fs.renameSync(withdrawalTempPath, withdrawalCapturePath);
        }
        response.writeHead(upstreamResponse.statusCode || 502, upstreamResponse.headers);
        response.end(responseBody);
      });
    });
    proxyRequest.on('error', (error) => {
      response.writeHead(502, { 'content-type': 'application/json' });
      response.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE', message: error.message }));
    });
    proxyRequest.end(bodyBuffer);
  });
});

server.listen(port, '127.0.0.1', () => {
  console.log(`Recording proxy listening on http://127.0.0.1:${port}; capture file: ${outputPath}`);
});

function shutdown() { server.close(() => process.exit(0)); }
process.on('SIGINT', shutdown);
process.on('SIGTERM', shutdown);

```

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');

const projectRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const experimentRoot = path.join(projectRoot, 'experiments');
const resultRoot = path.join(experimentRoot, 'results');
const outputPath = path.join(projectRoot, 'docs', 'EXPERIMENTS.md');
const manifestPath = path.join(resultRoot, 'SHA256SUMS.json');

function walk(directory) {
  return fs.readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })
    .sort((left, right) => left.name.localeCompare(right.name))
    .flatMap((entry) => {
      const absolutePath = path.join(directory, entry.name);
      return entry.isDirectory() ? walk(absolutePath) : [absolutePath];
    });
}

function refreshResultManifest() {
  const files = walk(resultRoot).filter((filePath) => path.resolve(filePath) !== path.resolve(manifestPath));
  const entries = files.map((filePath) => ({
    path: relativePath(filePath),
    sizeBytes: fs.statSync(filePath).size,
    sha256: crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(filePath)).digest('hex')
  }));
  fs.writeFileSync(manifestPath, `${JSON.stringify(entries, null, 2)}\n`, 'utf8');
}

function relativePath(absolutePath) {
  return path.relative(projectRoot, absolutePath).split(path.sep).join('/');
}

function sha256(absolutePath) {
  try {
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(absolutePath)).digest('hex');
  } catch (error) {
    return `unavailable while file is open: ${error.code || error.message}`;
  }
}

function fenceFor(text) {
  const longest = Math.max(0, ...Array.from(text.matchAll(/`+/g), (match) => match[0].length));
  return '`'.repeat(Math.max(3, longest + 1));
}

function languageFor(filePath) {
  const extension = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();
  return ({ '.js': 'js', '.json': 'json', '.csv': 'csv', '.log': 'text' })[extension] || 'text';
}

function percentile(sorted, percent) {
  if (!sorted.length) return null;
  const position = (sorted.length - 1) * percent;
  const lower = Math.floor(position);
  const upper = Math.ceil(position);
  return lower === upper ? sorted[lower] : sorted[lower] + (sorted[upper] - sorted[lower]) * (position - lower);
}

function aggregate(values) {
  const sorted = values.filter(Number.isFinite).sort((left, right) => left - right);
  if (!sorted.length) return { count: 0, min: null, max: null, mean: null, p50: null, p95: null, p99: null };
  return { count: sorted.length, min: sorted[0], max: sorted[sorted.length - 1],
    mean: sorted.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / sorted.length,
    p50: percentile(sorted, 0.5), p95: percentile(sorted, 0.95), p99: percentile(sorted, 0.99) };
}

function parseCsv(line) {
  const cells = []; let cell = ''; let quoted = false;
  for (let index = 0; index < line.length; index += 1) {
    const char = line[index];
    if (char === '"' && quoted && line[index + 1] === '"') { cell += '"'; index += 1; }
    else if (char === '"') quoted = !quoted;
    else if (char === ',' && !quoted) { cells.push(cell); cell = ''; }
    else cell += char;
  }
  cells.push(cell); return cells;
}

function largeFileSummary(filePath, text, rows) {
  const aggregates = {};
  if (path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase() === '.csv' && rows.length > 1) {
    const headers = parseCsv(rows[0]); const columns = headers.map(() => []);
    for (const row of rows.slice(1)) parseCsv(row).forEach((value, index) => {
      if (!/(?:hash|_?id$|token|signature|nonce|key)/i.test(headers[index]) && value !== '' && /^[-+]?(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?$/.test(value)) columns[index].push(Number(value));
    });
    headers.forEach((header, index) => { if (columns[index].length) aggregates[header] = aggregate(columns[index]); });
  } else {
    const numbers = [...text.matchAll(/(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])[-+]?(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?/g)].map((match) => Number(match[0]));
    aggregates.numericValues = aggregate(numbers);
  }
  return { totalRows: rows.length, first20: rows.slice(0, 20), last20: rows.slice(-20), aggregates };
}

function redactAuthenticationArtifacts(filePath, text) {
  if (/\.json$/i.test(filePath)) {
    text = text.replace(/("signature"\s*:\s*")[^"]*(")/gi, '$1[REDACTED SIGNATURE]$2');
  }
  if (/\.(json|log)$/i.test(filePath)) {
    text = text.replace(/((?:preserved )?signature:\s*)[0-9a-f]{16,}/gi, '$1[REDACTED SIGNATURE]');
  }
  return text;
}

function buildTree(files) {
  const nodes = new Map();
  for (const absolutePath of files) {
    const rel = path.relative(experimentRoot, absolutePath).split(path.sep);
    let current = '';
    for (let index = 0; index < rel.length; index += 1) {
      current = current ? `${current}/${rel[index]}` : rel[index];
      if (!nodes.has(current)) nodes.set(current, { name: rel[index], isDirectory: index < rel.length - 1 });
    }
  }
  const children = new Map();
  for (const [key, node] of nodes) {
    const parent = key.includes('/') ? key.slice(0, key.lastIndexOf('/')) : '';
    if (!children.has(parent)) children.set(parent, []);
    children.get(parent).push({ ...node, key });
  }
  const lines = ['experiments/'];
  function emit(parent, prefix) {
    const entries = (children.get(parent) || []).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    entries.forEach((entry, index) => {
      const last = index === entries.length - 1;
      lines.push(`${prefix}${last ? '└── ' : '├── '}${entry.name}${entry.isDirectory ? '/' : ''}`);
      if (entry.isDirectory) emit(entry.key, `${prefix}${last ? '    ' : '│   '}`);
    });
  }
  emit('', '');
  return lines.join('\n');
}

refreshResultManifest();

const cases = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(resultRoot, 'baseline', 'measured-cases.json'), 'utf8'));
const nonceGrowth = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(resultRoot, 'baseline', 'nonce-growth-measured.json'), 'utf8'));

const lines = [];
const add = (...items) => lines.push(...items);
const code = String.fromCharCode(96);
add(

  '```',

  '|---|---:|---|'

for (const absolutePath of allFiles) {
  const rel = relativePath(absolutePath);
  const stat = fs.statSync(absolutePath);
  const listedHash = manifestHashes.get(rel);
  const digest = listedHash || sha256(absolutePath);
  add(`| ${code}${rel}${code} | ${stat.size} | ${code}${digest}${code} |`);
}

const correctionArtifacts = path.join(resultRoot, 'corrections');
if (fs.existsSync(correctionArtifacts)) {
  add('', '## Phase 0 correction measurements', '', 'These are scoped correction checks. Phase 4 E1–E4 results and any v2 reruns are reported in `docs/RESULTS_PACK_A.md` and the matching raw run directories.', '');
  const memoryFiles = fs.readdirSync(correctionArtifacts).filter((name) => /^nonce-memory-(accepted-prep-accepted-clean|requestid-prep-requestid)-.*summary\.json$/.test(name));
  for (const name of memoryFiles) {
    const result = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(correctionArtifacts, name), 'utf8'));
    add(`### ${result.label}`, '', `- Mode: ${result.mode}; requests: ${result.requestCount}.`, `- NONCE_TTL: ${result.nonceTtlSeconds} seconds; duration: ${result.durationSeconds} seconds (${result.durationVsTtl} of TTL).`, `- Empty namespace memory baseline: ${result.baselineUsedMemoryBytes} bytes.`, `- Baseline-subtracted slope at 100,000 keys: ${result.baselineSubtractedSlopeBytesPerKey} bytes/key.`, `- Request timings: ${code}corrections/${result.requestRowsCsv}${code}.`, '');
    for (const snapshot of result.snapshots) add(`- ${snapshot.measuredKeys} keys: ${snapshot.usedMemoryBytes} bytes; delta ${snapshot.deltaBytes}; baseline-subtracted ${snapshot.bytesPerKeyAboveBaseline ?? 'n/a'} bytes/key; elapsed ${snapshot.elapsedSeconds ?? 0} seconds.`);
    add('');
  }
  const racePath = path.join(correctionArtifacts, 'race-summary-1000-batches.json');
  if (fs.existsSync(racePath)) {
    const race = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(racePath, 'utf8'));
    add('### Race repeatability', '', `- ${race.identicalPayloadRace.totalRequests} identical replay requests over ${race.identicalPayloadRace.batches} batches of ${race.identicalPayloadRace.parallelWidth}; accepted-count distribution: ${JSON.stringify(race.identicalPayloadRace.acceptedCountDistribution)}.`, `- Secret-holder same-request-ID race: ${race.secretHolderSameRequestIdRace.parallelWidth} different signed payloads; ${race.secretHolderSameRequestIdRace.acceptedCount} accepted; debit ${race.secretHolderSameRequestIdRace.debitAmount}; oracle ${JSON.stringify(race.secretHolderSameRequestIdRace.oracle)}.`, '');
  }
  const boundaryPath = path.join(correctionArtifacts, 'timestamp-boundaries-30-each.json');
  if (fs.existsSync(boundaryPath)) {
    const boundary = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(boundaryPath, 'utf8'));
    add('### Clock boundary repetitions', '', `- Repetitions per edge/case: ${boundary.repetitionsPerCase}.`, `- First rejected past age: ${boundary.firstRejectedPastAgeSeconds}s; first rejected future offset: +${boundary.firstRejectedFutureOffsetSeconds}s.`, `- Raw per-request timing CSV: ${code}corrections/timestamp-boundaries-30-each.csv${code}.`, '');
  }
  const clockOffsetsPath = path.join(correctionArtifacts, 'clock-offsets-30-each.json');
  if (fs.existsSync(clockOffsetsPath)) {
    const clockOffsets = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(clockOffsetsPath, 'utf8'));
    add('### Repeated Phase 0 client clock offsets', '', `- Repetitions per offset: ${clockOffsets.repetitionsPerOffset}; all rows record request start/end/duration.`, `- Outcomes: ${clockOffsets.cases.map((item) => `${item.label} ${item.offsetMs}ms => ${item.expected} (${item.measuredCount}/${clockOffsets.repetitionsPerOffset})`).join('; ')}.`, `- Raw per-request timing CSV: ${code}corrections/clock-offsets-30-each.csv${code}.`, '');
  }
  const vizPath = path.join(correctionArtifacts, 'viz-enabled-nonce-scan-summary.json');
  if (fs.existsSync(vizPath)) {
    const viz = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(vizPath, 'utf8'));
    add('### Dashboard scan overhead', '', '- Measured once with VIZ_ENABLED=true. This is an implementation artifact of demo key scanning, not a defense property.', `- Samples: ${viz.nonceKeySamples.map((sample) => `${sample.nonceKeysAtDashboardScan} keys: ${sample.duration_ms} ms`).join('; ')}.`, '');
  }
}

add('', '## Complete file contents', '', 'Source code is included in full. Small result files are included in full. For any result over 200 KB or 1,000 rows, only the first 20 rows, last 20 rows, and aggregate statistics are included; the full result stays on disk. Signature values are redacted in this dossier.', '');

for (const absolutePath of allFiles) {
  const rel = relativePath(absolutePath);
  const stat = fs.statSync(absolutePath);
  add(`### ${code}${rel}${code}`, '', `Bytes: ${stat.size}. SHA-256: ${code}${manifestHashes.get(rel) || sha256(absolutePath)}${code}.`, '');
  if (stat.size === 0) {
    add('_Empty file (0 bytes)._','');
    continue;
  }
  let text = fs.readFileSync(absolutePath, 'utf8');
  text = redactAuthenticationArtifacts(rel, text);
  const rows = text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
  if (rows.at(-1) === '') rows.pop();
  const isResult = absolutePath.startsWith(`${resultRoot}${path.sep}`) && rel !== 'experiments/results/SHA256SUMS.json';
  if (isResult && /nonce-memory-(accepted|requestid)-c2-.*summary\.json$/i.test(path.basename(absolutePath))) {
    add('Older C2 nonce-memory summary excluded from numeric reporting: the raw INFO evidence required for the canonical comparison was not preserved. The raw file remains on disk and is listed with its hash above.', '');
    continue;
  }
  if (isResult && (stat.size > 200 * 1024 || rows.length > 1000)) {
    const summary = largeFileSummary(absolutePath, text, rows);
    const excerpt = [...summary.first20, '... omitted rows ...', ...summary.last20].join('\n');
    add('Large-result rule applied. The complete result remains on disk.', '', `Total rows: ${summary.totalRows}.`, '', 'Aggregate statistics (counts, min, max, mean, p50, p95, and p99 for numeric columns):', '', `${code.repeat(3)}json`, JSON.stringify(summary.aggregates, null, 2), code.repeat(3), '', `${code.repeat(3)}${languageFor(rel)}`, excerpt, code.repeat(3), '');
    continue;
  }
  const fence = fenceFor(text);
  add(`${fence}${languageFor(rel)}`, text.endsWith('\n') ? text.slice(0, -1) : text, fence, '');
}

function readLog(name) {
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(resultRoot, 'baseline', name), 'utf8');
}

fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, `${lines.join('\n')}\n`, 'utf8');
process.stdout.write(`Wrote ${relativePath(outputPath)} with ${allFiles.length} experiment files.\n`);

### `experiments/render-pack-a.py` (80 lines)

```
import csv
import os
import sys

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
e1_dir = os.path.join(root, 'experiments', 'results', 'e1-sqlite-final')
e2_dir = os.path.join(root, 'experiments', 'results', 'e2')

with open(os.path.join(e1_dir, 'summary.csv'), newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    e1_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
configs = []
scenarios = [f'S{i}' for i in range(1, 10)]
for row in e1_rows:
    if row['scenario_id'] in scenarios and row['config_id'] not in configs:
        configs.append(row['config_id'])
matrix = np.full((len(configs), len(scenarios)), np.nan)
for row in e1_rows:
    if row['scenario_id'] in scenarios and row['config_id'] in configs and row['attack_success_rate']:
        matrix[configs.index(row['config_id']), scenarios.index(row['scenario_id'])] = float(row['attack_success_rate'])
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, max(6, len(configs) * 0.42)), constrained_layout=True)
image = ax.imshow(matrix, cmap='YlOrRd', vmin=0, vmax=1, aspect='auto')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(scenarios)), scenarios)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(configs)), configs)
ax.set_xlabel('Attack scenario')
ax.set_ylabel('Defense configuration')
ax.set_title('E1 attack success rate (SQLite ledger debit count / attempts)')
for i in range(len(configs)):
    for j in range(len(scenarios)):
        value = matrix[i, j]
        ax.text(j, i, '—' if np.isnan(value) else f'{value:.2f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, color='black')
fig.colorbar(image, ax=ax, label='Attack success rate')
for ext in ('png', 'pdf', 'svg'):
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(e1_dir, f'attack-success-heatmap.{ext}'), dpi=200)
plt.close(fig)

with open(os.path.join(e2_dir, 'load-repeat-summary.csv'), newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    e2_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
stacks = list(dict.fromkeys(row['stack_id'] for row in e2_rows))
x = np.arange(len(stacks))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 6), constrained_layout=True)
width = 0.36
for offset, concurrency in enumerate(('1', '16')):
    vals, low, high = [], [], []
    for stack in stacks:
        row = next((item for item in e2_rows if item['stack_id'] == stack and item['concurrency'] == concurrency), None)
        vals.append(float(row['mean_repeat_median_ms']) if row else 0)
        low.append(float(row['mean_repeat_median_ms']) - float(row['ci95_low_ms']) if row else 0)
        high.append(float(row['ci95_high_ms']) - float(row['mean_repeat_median_ms']) if row else 0)
    ax.bar(x + (offset - .5) * width, vals, width, yerr=[low, high], capsize=3, label=f'Concurrency {concurrency}')
ax.set_xticks(x, stacks, rotation=30, ha='right')
ax.set_ylabel('Mean per-repeat median latency (ms)')
ax.set_title('E2 end-to-end latency with 95% CI across five repeat medians')
ax.legend()
for ext in ('png', 'pdf', 'svg'):
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(e2_dir, f'latency-by-stack.{ext}'), dpi=200)
plt.close(fig)

with open(os.path.join(e2_dir, 'load-repeat-summary.csv'), newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
with open(os.path.join(e2_dir, 'load-summary.tex'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write('\\begin{tabular}{lrrrrr}\n\\toprule\nStack & C & Mean median (ms) & 95\\% CI low & 95\\% CI high & Repeats \\\\\n\\midrule\n')
    for row in rows:
        f.write(f"{row['stack_id']} & {row['concurrency']} & {float(row['mean_repeat_median_ms']):.4f} & {float(row['ci95_low_ms']):.4f} & {float(row['ci95_high_ms']):.4f} & {row['repetitions']} \\\\\n")
    f.write('\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular}\n')

with open(os.path.join(e2_dir, 'rejection-cost.csv'), newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
with open(os.path.join(e2_dir, 'rejection-cost.tex'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write('\\begin{tabular}{llrrrr}\n\\toprule\nOrder & Flood & Attempts & Mean ms & p95 ms & Rejected \\\\\n\\midrule\n')
    for row in rows:
        f.write(f"{row['check_order']} & {row['flood']} & {row['attempts']} & {float(row['mean_duration_ms']):.4f} & {float(row['p95_ms']):.4f} & {row['rejected_count']} \\\\\n")
    f.write('\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular}\n')

print(f'matplotlib {matplotlib.__version__}; wrote E1 heatmap and E2 latency figure in PNG, PDF, SVG plus LaTeX tables')

import csv, os, sys

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

ROOT=os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
E1=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e1-v2')
E2ROOT=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e2-v2')
E2=E2ROOT
if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(E2,'load-repeat-summary.csv')) and os.path.isdir(E2ROOT):
    candidates=[os.path.join(E2ROOT,n) for n in os.listdir(E2ROOT) if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(E2ROOT,n)) and os.path.exists(os.path.join(E2ROOT,n,'load-repeat-summary.csv'))]
    if candidates:E2=max(candidates,key=os.path.getmtime)
E3=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e3-v2')
E4=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e4-v2')
E4C=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e4-v2-corrected')
def read(path):
    with open(path,newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f:return list(csv.DictReader(f))
def save(fig,directory,name):
    os.makedirs(directory,exist_ok=True)
    for ext in ('png','pdf','svg'):fig.savefig(os.path.join(directory,f'{name}.{ext}'),dpi=180)

e1run=read(os.path.join(E1,'summary.csv'))
S11=os.path.join(ROOT,'experiments','results','e1-v2-s11','summary.csv')
if os.path.exists(S11):
    s11rows=read(S11)
    e1run=[r for r in e1run if r['scenario_id']!='S11']+[r for r in s11rows if r['scenario_id']=='S11']
scenarios=list(dict.fromkeys(r['scenario_id'] for r in e1run if r['scenario_id']!='LEGITIMATE_CONTROL'))
configs=list(dict.fromkeys(r['config_id'] for r in e1run if '-DEFAULT' not in r['config_id']))
matrix=np.full((len(configs),len(scenarios)),np.nan)
for r in e1run:
    if r['config_id'] in configs and r['scenario_id'] in scenarios and r['attack_success_rate']!='':matrix[configs.index(r['config_id']),scenarios.index(r['scenario_id'])]=float(r['attack_success_rate'])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(max(12,len(scenarios)*.85),max(6,len(configs)*.38)),constrained_layout=True)
im=ax.imshow(matrix,vmin=0,vmax=1,cmap='YlOrRd',aspect='auto');ax.set_xticks(range(len(scenarios)),scenarios,rotation=35,ha='right');ax.set_yticks(range(len(configs)),configs);ax.set_xlabel('Scenario');ax.set_ylabel('Defense configuration');ax.set_title('E1 v2 attack success rate (SQLite ledger oracle)')
for i in range(len(configs)):
    for j in range(len(scenarios)):
        if np.isfinite(matrix[i,j]):ax.text(j,i,f'{matrix[i,j]:.2f}',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=6)
fig.colorbar(im,ax=ax,label='Debited / attempts');save(fig,E1,'attack-success-heatmap');plt.close(fig)
tex=['\\begin{tabular}{l'+'c'*len(scenarios)+'}','\\toprule','Configuration & '+' & '.join(scenarios)+' \\\\','\\midrule']
for i,c in enumerate(configs):tex.append(c+' & '+' & '.join('---' if not np.isfinite(matrix[i,j]) else f'{matrix[i,j]:.2f}' for j in range(len(scenarios)))+' \\\\')
tex+=['\\bottomrule','\\end{tabular}'];open(os.path.join(E1,'coverage-matrix.tex'),'w',encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(tex)+'\n')
if os.path.exists(S11):
    with open(os.path.join(E1,'coverage-provenance.txt'),'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
        import hashlib

```
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const { timedRequest } = require('./lib/http');

const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const runTag = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-');
const output = path.join(__dirname, 'results', 'phase4-source-fixes', `race-session-final-${runTag}`);
const serverOutput = path.join(output, 'server.stdout.log');
const serverError = path.join(output, 'server.stderr.log');
fs.mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true });

function spawnLogged(script, cwd, env, stdoutPath, stderrPath) {
  const stdout = fs.openSync(stdoutPath, 'a');
  const stderr = fs.openSync(stderrPath, 'a');
  const child = spawn(process.execPath, [script], { cwd, env, stdio: ['ignore', stdout, stderr], windowsHide: true });
  child.once('exit', () => { fs.closeSync(stdout); fs.closeSync(stderr); });
  return child;
}
function waitExit(child) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => child.once('exit', (code, signal) => resolve({ code, signal })));
}
async function stop(child) {
  if (!child || child.exitCode !== null) return;
  child.kill();
  await Promise.race([waitExit(child), new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000))]);
  if (child.exitCode === null && child.pid && process.platform === 'win32') {
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      const killer = spawn('taskkill', ['/PID', String(child.pid), '/T', '/F'], { stdio: 'ignore', windowsHide: true });
      killer.once('exit', resolve);
    });
  }
}
async function waitHealth(child, port) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + 30000;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (child.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`Measured server exited early; inspect ${serverError}`);
    try {
      const response = await timedRequest(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/health`);
      if (response.status === 200) return;
    } catch {}
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200));
  }
  throw new Error(`Measured server health timed out; inspect ${serverError}`);
}

async function main() {
  const port = 3110;
  const database = path.join(output, 'race-session.sqlite');
  const baseEnvironment = {
    ...process.env,
    PORT: String(port), HOST: '127.0.0.1', VIZ_PORT: '3111', VIZ_ENABLED: 'false', DEMO_MODE: 'false',
    LEGACY_SHARED_SECRET: 'false', ENABLE_DEMO_ROUTES: 'true',
    DEFENSE_HMAC: 'true', DEFENSE_TIMESTAMP: 'true', DEFENSE_NONCE: 'true', DEFENSE_REQUEST_ID: 'true',
    CHECK_ORDER: 'hmac,timestamp,nonce,request_id,balance',
    TIMESTAMP_PAST_WINDOW_SECONDS: '300', TIMESTAMP_FUTURE_WINDOW_SECONDS: '5',
    NONCE_BACKEND: 'redis', NONCE_TTL: '3600', NONCE_STORE_FAIL_MODE: 'fail-closed',
    NONCE_KEY_NAMESPACE: `f1-race-${runTag}`, REDIS_URL: 'redis://127.0.0.1:6379',
    SESSION_TTL: '3600', SQLITE_DB: database, EXPERIMENT_LOG: path.join(output, 'server-timings.csv'),
    CONFIG_ID: 'F1-session-all-defenses', SCENARIO_ID: 'race', RUN_ID: runTag
  };
  const server = spawnLogged('server.js', path.join(root, 'server'), baseEnvironment, serverOutput, serverError);
  try {
    await waitHealth(server, port);
    const raceEnvironment = {
      ...baseEnvironment, EXPERIMENT_API: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`, RACE_DB_PATH: database,
      RACE_BATCHES: '1000', RACE_OUTPUT: output
    };
    const runner = spawnLogged('run-races.js', __dirname, raceEnvironment, path.join(output, 'race-runner.stdout.log'), path.join(output, 'race-runner.stderr.log'));
    const result = await waitExit(runner);
    if (result.code !== 0) throw new Error(`Race runner failed with exit ${result.code} (${result.signal || 'no signal'}); inspect ${output}`);
    process.stdout.write(`Session-mode F1 races completed. Raw output: ${output}\n`);
  } finally {
    await stop(server);
  }
}

main().catch((error) => { process.stderr.write(`${error.stack || error.message}\n`); process.exitCode = 1; });

```

### `experiments/run-nonce-memory.js` (118 lines)

```
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');
const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
require('../server/node_modules/dotenv').config({ path: path.resolve(__dirname, '../server/.env') });
const { generateSignature } = require('../server/utils/hmac');
const { timedRequest } = require('./lib/http');

const mode = process.argv[2];
if (!['accepted', 'requestid'].includes(mode)) throw new Error('Usage: node experiments/run-nonce-memory.js accepted|requestid');
const baseUrl = process.env.EXPERIMENT_API || 'http://127.0.0.1:3000';
const runId = process.env.RUN_ID || `${mode}-${Date.now()}`;
const ttlSeconds = Number(process.env.NONCE_TTL || 86400);
const points = (process.env.MEMORY_POINTS || '0,1000,10000,100000').split(',').map(Number);
const output = path.join(__dirname, 'results', 'corrections');
const cli = process.env.MEMURAI_CLI || 'C:/Applications/memurai-cli.exe';
fs.mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true });

function parseInfo(text) {
  return Object.fromEntries(text.split(/\r?\n/).filter((line) => line && !line.startsWith('#') && line.includes(':')).map((line) => {
    const split = line.indexOf(':'); return [line.slice(0, split), line.slice(split + 1)];
  }));
}

function memoryBytes(label, rawInfoPath) {
  const raw = execFileSync(cli, ['INFO', 'memory'], { encoding: 'utf8' });
  fs.appendFileSync(rawInfoPath, `\n[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${label}\n${raw}\n`);
  const info = parseInfo(raw);
  return Number(info.used_memory);
}

function namespaceKeyCount(namespace) {
  const scan = execFileSync(cli, ['--scan', '--pattern', `used_nonce:${namespace}:*`], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 32 * 1024 * 1024 });
  return scan.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).length;
}

function signedPayload(requestId) {
  const payload = {
    method: 'POST', path: '/api/deposit', user_id: 'anis_101', account_id: 'acc_777',
    amount: 1, currency: 'BDT', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    nonce: `nonce_${crypto.randomUUID()}`, request_id: requestId
  };
  payload.signature = generateSignature(payload, process.env.HMAC_SECRET);
  return payload;
}

async function post(payload, runRows, index) {
  const result = await timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/deposit`, {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  });
  runRows.push({ index, ...result });
  if (mode === 'accepted' && result.body.status !== 'ACCEPTED') throw new Error(`Request ${index} rejected: ${JSON.stringify(result.body)}`);
  if (mode === 'requestid' && index !== 'seed' && result.body.reason !== 'ALREADY_PROCESSED') throw new Error(`Request ${index} did not reach request-ID check: ${JSON.stringify(result.body)}`);
  return result;
}

async function main() {
  const namespace = process.env.NONCE_KEY_NAMESPACE;
  if (!namespace) throw new Error('Set NONCE_KEY_NAMESPACE before starting the server and harness');
  const controlRows = [];
  const reset = await timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/reset`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' });
  controlRows.push({ name: 'reset', ...reset });
  let duplicateRequestId = null;
  if (mode === 'requestid') {
    duplicateRequestId = `seed_${runId}`;
    const seed = await post(signedPayload(duplicateRequestId), [], 'seed');
    controlRows.push({ name: 'seed', ...seed });
    const clear = await timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/demo/nonce-crash`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' });
    controlRows.push({ name: 'nonce-store-clear', ...clear });
  }

  const rawInfoPath = path.join(output, `nonce-memory-${mode}-${runId}-raw-info.log`);
  fs.writeFileSync(rawInfoPath, '');
  const baselineMemory = memoryBytes('baseline-empty-store', rawInfoPath);
  const baselineKeys = namespaceKeyCount(namespace);
  if (baselineKeys !== 0) throw new Error(`Expected an empty run namespace, found ${baselineKeys} keys`);
  const snapshots = [{ targetKeys: 0, measuredKeys: 0, usedMemoryBytes: baselineMemory, baselineUsedMemoryBytes: baselineMemory, deltaBytes: 0, bytesPerKeyAboveBaseline: null, elapsed_ns: '0', ttlSeconds }];
  const csvPath = path.join(output, `nonce-memory-${mode}-${runId}-requests.csv`);
  const rows = ['index,started_ns,ended_ns,duration_ns,http_status,outcome'];
  const requestRows = [];
  const runStart = process.hrtime.bigint();
  let sent = 0;
  for (const target of points.slice(1)) {
    while (sent < target) {
      sent += 1;
      const id = mode === 'requestid' ? duplicateRequestId : `accepted_${runId}_${sent}`;
      await post(signedPayload(id), requestRows, sent);
    }
    const elapsed = process.hrtime.bigint() - runStart;
    const actualKeys = namespaceKeyCount(namespace);
    const usedMemory = memoryBytes(`${target}-keys`, rawInfoPath);
    if (actualKeys !== target) throw new Error(`Expected ${target} live nonce keys, found ${actualKeys}`);
    if (Number(elapsed) / 1e9 >= ttlSeconds) throw new Error(`Run exceeded NONCE_TTL before snapshot ${target}`);
    snapshots.push({ targetKeys: target, measuredKeys: actualKeys, usedMemoryBytes: usedMemory, baselineUsedMemoryBytes: baselineMemory,
      deltaBytes: usedMemory - baselineMemory, bytesPerKeyAboveBaseline: (usedMemory - baselineMemory) / actualKeys,
      elapsed_ns: elapsed.toString(), elapsedSeconds: Number(elapsed) / 1e9, ttlSeconds, ttlFractionUsed: Number(elapsed) / 1e9 / ttlSeconds });
  }
  const runEnd = process.hrtime.bigint();
  for (const row of requestRows) rows.push([row.index, row.start_ns, row.end_ns, row.duration_ns, row.status, row.body.reason || row.body.status || ''].join(','));
  fs.writeFileSync(csvPath, `${rows.join('\n')}\n`);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(output, `nonce-memory-${mode}-${runId}-control.csv`), [
    'name,started_ns,ended_ns,duration_ns,http_status,outcome',
    ...controlRows.map((row) => [row.name, row.start_ns, row.end_ns, row.duration_ns, row.status, row.body.status || row.body.ok || ''].join(','))
  ].join('\n') + '\n');
  const summary = {
    runId, mode, nonceBackend: process.env.NONCE_STORE || 'redis', vizEnabled: process.env.VIZ_ENABLED === 'true', label: mode === 'requestid' ? 'nonce-store growth from requests rejected at the request-ID check' : 'nonce-store growth from accepted requests',
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), nonceTtlSeconds: ttlSeconds, duration_ns: (runEnd - runStart).toString(),
    durationSeconds: Number(runEnd - runStart) / 1e9, durationVsTtl: Number(runEnd - runStart) / 1e9 / ttlSeconds,
    baselineUsedMemoryBytes: baselineMemory, baselineNonceKeys: baselineKeys, snapshots,
    baselineSubtractedSlopeBytesPerKey: (snapshots.at(-1).usedMemoryBytes - baselineMemory) / 100000,
    requestRowsCsv: path.basename(csvPath), controlRowsCsv: `nonce-memory-${mode}-${runId}-control.csv`, rawInfoLog: path.basename(rawInfoPath), requestCount: sent
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(output, `nonce-memory-${mode}-${runId}-summary.json`), `${JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)}\n`);
  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)}\n`);
}

main().catch((error) => { process.stderr.write(`${error.stack || error.message}\n`); process.exitCode = 1; });

### `experiments/run-races.js` (117 lines)

```
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');
require('../server/node_modules/dotenv').config({ path: path.resolve(__dirname, '../server/.env') });
const { generateSignature } = require('../server/utils/hmac');
const { computeMoneyIntegrity } = require('../server/utils/money-oracle');
const { timedRequest } = require('./lib/http');
const sqlite3 = require('../server/node_modules/sqlite3').verbose();

const baseUrl = process.env.EXPERIMENT_API || 'http://127.0.0.1:3000';
if (!['127.0.0.1', 'localhost'].includes(new URL(baseUrl).hostname)) throw new Error('Race traffic is restricted to the local simulation at localhost.');
const output = process.env.RACE_OUTPUT || path.join(__dirname, 'results', 'corrections');
const batches = Number(process.env.RACE_BATCHES || 1000);
const width = 50;
const randomSeed = 'f1-race-fixed-seed-2026-v1';
let tokenSequence = 0;
function deterministicToken(label) { return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${randomSeed}|${label}|${tokenSequence++}`).digest('hex').slice(0, 32); }
fs.mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true });

let session;
function makePayload(requestId = `request_${deterministicToken('request')}`, nonce = `nonce_${deterministicToken('nonce')}`) {
  const payload = { method: 'POST', path: '/api/withdraw', user_id: 'anis_101', account_id: 'acc_777', amount: 1,
    currency: 'BDT', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), nonce, request_id: requestId };
  payload.signature = generateSignature(payload, session.sessionKey);
  return payload;
}

async function request(payload) {
  return timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/withdraw`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', authorization: `Bearer ${session.sessionToken}` }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
}

function writeRows(filename, header, rows) {
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(output, filename), `${[header, ...rows].join('\n')}\n`);
}

async function main() {
  const login = await timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/login`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ user_id: 'anis_101', pin: process.env.DEMO_PIN || '1234' }) });
  if (login.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Session login failed: ${login.status}`);
  session = login.body;
  const ledgerPath = process.env.RACE_DB_PATH || process.env.SQLITE_DB;
  if (!ledgerPath) throw new Error('Set RACE_DB_PATH to the SQLite database used by the measured server.');
  const ledgerDb = new sqlite3.Database(ledgerPath);
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => ledgerDb.once('open', resolve).once('error', reject));
  const readLedger = () => new Promise((resolve, reject) => ledgerDb.all('SELECT request_id,type,status,amount FROM transactions ORDER BY id', [], (error, rows) => error ? reject(error) : resolve(rows)));
  const signedRequest = (payload) => { payload.signature = generateSignature(payload, session.sessionKey); return payload; };
  const perRequestRows = [];
  const batchRows = [];
  const batchOracleRows = [];
  const acceptedDistribution = {};
  const balanceDeltaDistribution = {};
  for (let batch = 1; batch <= batches; batch += 1) {
    const reset = await timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/reset`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' });
    if (reset.status !== 200) throw new Error(`Reset failed before batch ${batch}`);
    const payload = makePayload();
    const start = process.hrtime.bigint();
    const responses = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, () => request(payload)));
    const end = process.hrtime.bigint();
    const accepted = responses.filter((response) => response.body.status === 'ACCEPTED').length;
    const reasons = responses.reduce((map, response) => {
      const reason = response.body.reason || response.body.status || 'UNKNOWN'; map[reason] = (map[reason] || 0) + 1; return map;
    }, {});
    const ledger = await readLedger();
    const oracle = computeMoneyIntegrity(ledger, [{ request_id: payload.request_id, amount: payload.amount, type: 'WITHDRAW' }]);
    if (!oracle.integrity_holds || oracle.total_debited !== 1) throw new Error(`Money oracle failed in batch ${batch}`);
    batchOracleRows.push(oracle);
    const balance = await timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/balance/anis_101`, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${session.sessionToken}` } });
    const balanceDelta = 10000 - balance.body.balance;
    balanceDeltaDistribution[balanceDelta] = (balanceDeltaDistribution[balanceDelta] || 0) + 1;
    acceptedDistribution[accepted] = (acceptedDistribution[accepted] || 0) + 1;
    batchRows.push([batch, accepted, reasons.NONCE_FAIL || 0, oracle.total_debited, oracle.duplicate_debit_count, oracle.duplicate_debit_amount, oracle.unauthorized_debit_amount, oracle.integrity_holds, balanceDelta, (end - start).toString(), reset.start_ns, reset.end_ns, reset.duration_ns].join(','));
    responses.forEach((response, index) => perRequestRows.push([batch, index + 1, response.start_ns, response.end_ns, response.duration_ns, response.status, response.body.reason || response.body.status || ''].join(',')));
    if (accepted !== 1) throw new Error(`Batch ${batch}: expected one acceptance, got ${accepted}`);
  }
  writeRows(`race-identical-50x${batches}-requests.csv`, 'batch,request_index,started_ns,ended_ns,duration_ns,http_status,outcome', perRequestRows);
  writeRows(`race-identical-50x${batches}-batches.csv`, 'batch,accepted_count,nonce_fail_count,oracle_total_debited,oracle_duplicate_debit_count,oracle_duplicate_debit_amount,oracle_unauthorized_debit_amount,oracle_integrity_holds,balance_delta,batch_duration_ns,reset_started_ns,reset_ended_ns,reset_duration_ns', batchRows);

  await timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/reset`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' });
  const sharedRequestId = `secret-holder-${deterministicToken('shared-request')}`;
  const payloads = Array.from({ length: width }, (_, index) => makePayload(sharedRequestId, `secret-holder-nonce-${index}-${deterministicToken(`shared-nonce-${index}`)}`));
  const before = await timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/balance/anis_101`, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${session.sessionToken}` } });
  const raceStart = process.hrtime.bigint();
  const race = await Promise.all(payloads.map(request));
  const raceEnd = process.hrtime.bigint();
  const after = await timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/balance/anis_101`, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${session.sessionToken}` } });
  const ledger = await readLedger();
  const authorized = payloads.map((payload) => ({ request_id: payload.request_id, amount: payload.amount, type: 'WITHDRAW' }));
  const oracle = computeMoneyIntegrity(ledger, authorized);
  const summary = {
    randomSeed,
    vizEnabled: process.env.VIZ_ENABLED === 'true',
    identicalPayloadRace: {
      batches, parallelWidth: width, acceptedCountDistribution: acceptedDistribution, balanceDeltaDistribution, acceptedPerBatch: 1, totalRequests: batches * width,
      moneyOracle: {
        ledgerReadDirectlyFromSqlite: true,
        evaluatedBatches: batchOracleRows.length,
        integrityHoldsForEveryBatch: batchOracleRows.every((oracle) => oracle.integrity_holds),
        totalDebitedAcrossFreshDatabaseResets: batchOracleRows.reduce((sum, oracle) => sum + oracle.total_debited, 0),
        duplicateDebitCount: batchOracleRows.reduce((sum, oracle) => sum + oracle.duplicate_debit_count, 0),
        duplicateDebitAmount: batchOracleRows.reduce((sum, oracle) => sum + oracle.duplicate_debit_amount, 0),
        unauthorizedDebitAmount: batchOracleRows.reduce((sum, oracle) => sum + oracle.unauthorized_debit_amount, 0)
      }
    },
    secretHolderSameRequestIdRace: {
      parallelWidth: width, acceptedCount: race.filter((result) => result.body.status === 'ACCEPTED').length,
      requestIdShared: true, distinctValidNonces: width, balanceDelta: Number(before.body.balance) - Number(after.body.balance),
      duration_ns: (raceEnd - raceStart).toString(), beforeBalanceTiming: before, afterBalanceTiming: after, oracle
    }
  };
  const sameIdRows = race.map((result, index) => [index + 1, result.start_ns, result.end_ns, result.duration_ns, result.status, result.body.reason || result.body.status || ''].join(','));
  writeRows('race-same-request-id-50-requests.csv', 'request_index,started_ns,ended_ns,duration_ns,http_status,outcome', sameIdRows);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(output, `race-summary-${batches}-batches.json`), `${JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)}\n`);
  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)}\n`);
  await new Promise((resolve) => ledgerDb.close(resolve));
}

main().catch((error) => { process.stderr.write(`${error.stack || error.message}\n`); process.exitCode = 1; });

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const crypto = require('crypto');
require('../server/node_modules/dotenv').config({ path: path.resolve(__dirname, '../server/.env') });
const { generateSignature } = require('../server/utils/hmac');
const { timedRequest } = require('./lib/http');

const baseUrl = process.env.EXPERIMENT_API || 'http://127.0.0.1:3000';
const output = path.join(__dirname, 'results', 'corrections');
const sampleCounts = new Set([1, 100, 1000, 5000]);
const maximum = 5000;
fs.mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true });

function makePayload(index) {
  const payload = { method: 'POST', path: '/api/deposit', user_id: 'anis_101', account_id: 'acc_777', amount: 1,
    currency: 'BDT', timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), nonce: `viz-${index}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`, request_id: `viz-${index}-${crypto.randomUUID()}` };
  payload.signature = generateSignature(payload, process.env.HMAC_SECRET);
  return payload;
}

async function main() {
  if (process.env.VIZ_ENABLED !== 'true') throw new Error('Start the measured server with VIZ_ENABLED=true');
  const reset = await timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/reset`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' });
  const requestRows = ['index,nonce_keys_at_dashboard_scan,started_ns,ended_ns,duration_ns,http_status,outcome'];
  const samples = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < maximum; index += 1) {
    const result = await timedRequest(`${baseUrl}/api/deposit`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(makePayload(index))
    });
    if (result.body.status !== 'ACCEPTED') throw new Error(`Visualization curve request ${index} failed: ${JSON.stringify(result.body)}`);
    requestRows.push([index + 1, index + 1, result.start_ns, result.end_ns, result.duration_ns, result.status, result.body.status].join(','));
    if (sampleCounts.has(index + 1)) samples.push({ nonceKeysAtDashboardScan: index + 1, duration_ns: result.duration_ns, duration_ms: Number(result.duration_ns) / 1e6, httpStatus: result.status });
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(output, 'viz-enabled-nonce-scan-requests.csv'), `${requestRows.join('\n')}\n`);
  const summary = { measuredOnce: true, vizEnabled: true, resetTiming: reset, label: 'dashboard per-request key-scan implementation artifact, not a defense property', nonceKeySamples: samples, allRequests: maximum };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(output, 'viz-enabled-nonce-scan-summary.json'), `${JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)}\n`);
  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)}\n`);
}
main().catch((error) => { process.stderr.write(`${error.stack || error.message}\n`); process.exitCode = 1; });
