function getTransactionByRequestId(db, requestId) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.get(
      'SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE request_id = ?', //query to find a transaction by request_id
      [requestId],
      (error, row) => {
        if (error) {
          reject(error);
          return;
        }
        resolve(row || null); // resolve with the found row or null if not found
      }
    );
  });
}

async function isRequestProcessed(db, requestId, policy = 'success_only') {
  const anyOutcome = policy === 'any_outcome';
  const row = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const sql = anyOutcome
      ? "SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE request_id = ? AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED') LIMIT 1"
      : "SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE request_id = ? AND status = 'SUCCESS' LIMIT 1";
    db.get(sql, [requestId], (error, result) => {
      if (error) return reject(error);
      resolve(result || null);
    });
  });
  return {
    processed: Boolean(row),
    row
  };
}

module.exports = {
  getTransactionByRequestId,
  isRequestProcessed
};

```

### `server/utils/money-oracle.js` (66 lines)

```
const crypto = require('crypto');

function payloadFingerprint(payload) {
  const stable = [
    payload.method, payload.path, payload.user_id, payload.account_id,
    payload.amount, payload.currency, payload.timestamp, payload.nonce,
    payload.request_id, payload.signature
  ].join('|');
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(stable).digest('hex');
}

function computeMoneyIntegrity(ledgerRows, authorizedIntents = []) {
  const authorized = new Map(authorizedIntents.map((intent) => [String(intent.request_id), {
    amount: Number(intent.amount), type: String(intent.type)
  }]));
  const debits = ledgerRows.filter((row) => row.status === 'SUCCESS' && row.type === 'WITHDRAW');
  const byRequestId = new Map();
  let unauthorizedDebitAmount = 0;
  let totalDebited = 0;
  for (const row of debits) {
    const amount = Number(row.amount);
    totalDebited += amount;
    const intent = authorized.get(String(row.request_id));
    if (!intent || intent.amount !== amount || intent.type !== 'WITHDRAW') unauthorizedDebitAmount += amount;
    const rows = byRequestId.get(String(row.request_id)) || [];
    rows.push(row);
    byRequestId.set(String(row.request_id), rows);
  }
  let duplicateDebitCount = 0;
  let duplicateDebitAmount = 0;
  let delayedExecutionCount = 0;
  let delayedExecutionAmount = 0;
  for (const rows of byRequestId.values()) {
    for (const duplicate of rows.slice(1)) {
      duplicateDebitCount += 1;
      duplicateDebitAmount += Number(duplicate.amount);
    }
  }
  const failedByRequestId = new Map();
  for (const row of ledgerRows) {
    if (row.status !== 'FAILED') continue;
    const key = String(row.request_id);
    const list = failedByRequestId.get(key) || [];
    list.push(Number(row.id ?? -Infinity));
    failedByRequestId.set(key, list);
  }
  for (const row of debits) {
    const failedIds = failedByRequestId.get(String(row.request_id)) || [];
    if (failedIds.some((id) => id < Number(row.id ?? Infinity))) {
      delayedExecutionCount += 1;
      delayedExecutionAmount += Number(row.amount);
    }
  }
  return {
    duplicate_debit_count: duplicateDebitCount,
    duplicate_debit_amount: duplicateDebitAmount,
    unauthorized_debit_amount: unauthorizedDebitAmount,
    delayed_execution_count: delayedExecutionCount,
    delayed_execution_amount: delayedExecutionAmount,
    total_debited: totalDebited,
    integrity_holds: duplicateDebitCount === 0 && unauthorizedDebitAmount === 0
  };
}

module.exports = { payloadFingerprint, computeMoneyIntegrity };

```

### `server/utils/nonce.js` (123 lines)

```
const DEFAULT_NONCE_TTL_SECONDS = 300;

function nonceKey(userId, nonce) {
  const namespace = process.env.NONCE_KEY_NAMESPACE;
  return namespace ? `used_nonce:${namespace}:${userId}:${nonce}` : `used_nonce:${userId}:${nonce}`;
}

function sqliteRun(db, sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => db.run(sql, params, function (error) {
    if (error) return reject(error);
    resolve(this);
  }));
}

function sqliteGet(db, sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => db.get(sql, params, (error, row) => {
    if (error) return reject(error);
    resolve(row || null);
  }));
}

function sweepExpiredMemory(store, now = Date.now()) {
  let removed = 0;
  for (const [entry, expiresAt] of store) {
    if (expiresAt <= now) { store.delete(entry); removed += 1; }
  }
  return removed;
}

function startNonceSweep({ backend, store, intervalMs = 60000, now = Date.now }) {
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    if (backend === 'memory') sweepExpiredMemory(store, now());
    else if (backend === 'sqlite') sqliteRun(store, 'DELETE FROM used_nonces WHERE expires_at <= ?', [now()]).catch(() => {});
  }, intervalMs);
  timer.unref?.();
  return timer;
}

async function verifyNonce(store, userId, nonce, options = {}) {
  const backend = options.backend || 'redis';
  const ttlSeconds = Number(options.ttlSeconds ?? process.env.NONCE_TTL ?? DEFAULT_NONCE_TTL_SECONDS);
  const now = typeof options.now === 'function' ? options.now() : Date.now();
  const key = nonceKey(userId, nonce);
  let valid;
  let result;

  if (backend === 'redis') {
    const redisResult = await store.set(key, '1', { NX: true, EX: ttlSeconds });
    valid = redisResult === 'OK';
    result = valid ? 'SETNX_SUCCESS' : 'SETNX_FAILED';
  } else if (backend === 'sqlite') {
    await sqliteRun(store, 'DELETE FROM used_nonces WHERE user_id = ? AND nonce = ? AND expires_at <= ?', [userId, nonce, now]);
    const inserted = await sqliteRun(store, 'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO used_nonces (user_id, nonce, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', [userId, nonce, now + ttlSeconds * 1000]);
    valid = inserted.changes === 1;
    result = valid ? 'SQLITE_INSERT_SUCCESS' : 'SQLITE_DUPLICATE';
  } else if (backend === 'memory') {
    const memKey = `${process.env.NONCE_KEY_NAMESPACE || ''}\u0000${userId}\u0000${nonce}`;
    const expiresAt = store.get(memKey);
    if (expiresAt !== undefined && expiresAt <= now) store.delete(memKey);
    valid = !store.has(memKey);
    if (valid) store.set(memKey, now + ttlSeconds * 1000);
    result = valid ? 'MEMORY_INSERT_SUCCESS' : 'MEMORY_DUPLICATE';
  } else {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported nonce backend: ${backend}`);
  }

  return {
    valid,
    key,
    redisResult: result
  };
}

async function verifyNonceResilient(store, userId, nonce, options = {}) {
  try {
    if (options.forceError) throw new Error('test-only injected nonce-store fault');
    return await verifyNonce(store, userId, nonce, options);
  } catch (error) {
    if ((options.failMode || 'fail-closed') === 'fail-open') return { valid: true, redisResult: 'STORE_ERROR_FAIL_OPEN', error };
    return { valid: false, redisResult: 'STORE_ERROR_FAIL_CLOSED', error };
  }
}

async function listNonceKeys(redisClient) {
  const keys = [];
  let cursor = 0;
  const namespace = process.env.NONCE_KEY_NAMESPACE;
  const pattern = namespace ? `used_nonce:${namespace}:*` : 'used_nonce:*';

  do {
    const reply = await redisClient.scan(cursor, {
      MATCH: pattern,
      COUNT: 100
    });
    cursor = Number(reply.cursor);
    keys.push(...reply.keys);
  } while (cursor !== 0);

  return keys.sort();
}

async function clearNonceKeys(redisClient) {
  const keys = await listNonceKeys(redisClient);
  if (keys.length > 0) {
    await redisClient.del(keys);
  }
  return keys;
}

module.exports = {
  NONCE_TTL_SECONDS: Number(process.env.NONCE_TTL || DEFAULT_NONCE_TTL_SECONDS),
  DEFAULT_NONCE_TTL_SECONDS,
  nonceKey,
  verifyNonce,
  verifyNonceResilient,
  sqliteRun,
  sqliteGet,
  sweepExpiredMemory,
  startNonceSweep,
  listNonceKeys,
  clearNonceKeys
};

function validSignedRequest(payload, type) {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return false;
  const fields = ['method', 'path', 'user_id', 'account_id', 'currency', 'timestamp', 'nonce', 'request_id'];
  if (fields.some((field) => typeof payload[field] !== 'string' || /[|\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(payload[field]))) return false;
  return payload.method === 'POST'
    && payload.path === `/api/${type.toLowerCase()}`
    && payload.user_id.length > 0
    && payload.account_id.length > 0
    && payload.currency.length > 0
    && payload.nonce.length > 0
    && payload.request_id.length > 0
    && Number.isSafeInteger(payload.amount)
    && payload.amount > 0
    && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(payload.timestamp));
}

module.exports = { validSignedRequest };

function isTimestampWithinWindow(timestamp, checkedAtMs, pastWindowSeconds, futureWindowSeconds) {
  const timestampMs = Date.parse(timestamp);
  if (!Number.isFinite(timestampMs)) return false;
  const ageSeconds = (checkedAtMs - timestampMs) / 1000;
  return ageSeconds >= -futureWindowSeconds && ageSeconds <= pastWindowSeconds;
}

module.exports = { isTimestampWithinWindow };

### `server/viz-server.js` (63 lines)

```
const { Server } = require('socket.io');

let io = null;
let serverInstance = null;

function startVizServer(options = {}) {
  if (io) {
    return io;
  }

  const port = Number(options.port || process.env.VIZ_PORT || 3001);

  io = new Server(port, {
    cors: {
      origin: '*',
      methods: ['GET', 'POST']
    }
  });

  io.on('connection', (socket) => {
    socket.emit('request-received', {
      user: 'dashboard',
      amount: 0,
      type: 'CONNECTED'
    });
  });

  serverInstance = io.httpServer;
  console.log(`Viz Socket.io server listening on port ${port}`);
  return io;
}

function emitVizEvent(eventName, data) {
  if (!io) {
    return;
  }
  io.emit(eventName, data);
}

function stopVizServer(callback) {
  if (!io || !serverInstance) {
    if (callback) callback();
    return;
  }

  io.close(() => {
    io = null;
    serverInstance = null;
    if (callback) callback();
  });
}

if (require.main === module) {
  require('dotenv').config();
  startVizServer();
}

module.exports = {
  startVizServer,
  emitVizEvent,
  stopVizServer
};

```
